hero.skill.shield.change_attack.name: Change Shield (Attack)
hero.skill.shield.change_attack.desc: The shield turns into its striking form: a cleaving blow in front of you after a short wind-up (green dust shows the cone). It hits for 6, and for up to 12 with a full Counter, and spends all the Counter. Needs a foe in reach.
hero.skill.shield.air_strike.name: Air Strike Shield
hero.skill.shield.air_strike.desc: A floating shield stands where you look (up to 12 blocks) for 8 seconds. It stops six shots from your enemies and nudges foes that touch it away. Two can stand at once.
hero.skill.shield.second_shield.name: Second Shield
hero.skill.shield.second_shield.desc: A second shield circles the friend you look at, or the nearest friend, or you. It soaks the next blows they take: 15 percent of their health (more as the bond grows, never above 30 points), for 10 seconds. You keep three of them at most.
hero.skill.shield.cover.name: Protect
hero.skill.shield.cover.desc: Protect: for 8 seconds 40 percent of every blow your friends within 12 blocks take is taken by you instead, and charges your Counter. It never takes you under a quarter of your health.
hero.skill.shield.provoke.name: Provoke
hero.skill.shield.provoke.desc: Hostile mobs within 10 blocks (not bosses) turn on you for 4 seconds, and you take a fifth less damage while they do.
hero.skill.shield.herb_mend.name: Herb Mend
hero.skill.shield.herb_mend.desc: The Leaf Shield's herbs: you and your friends within 5 blocks are mended by a tenth of their health (more as the bond grows), then regenerate for 5 seconds.
hero.skill.shield.prison.name: Shield Prison
hero.skill.shield.prison.desc: A cage of shields shuts round the foe you look at (up to 14 blocks). It cannot leave the cage and is slowed, for up to 4 seconds (a boss is held for one). Iron Maiden needs a foe held like this.
hero.skill.shield.chain.name: Chain Shield
hero.skill.shield.chain.desc: Chains bind up to four foes near where you look. For 3 seconds they are drawn together and bitten by the links, four pulses of 3 damage each.
hero.skill.shield.hook.name: Hook
hero.skill.shield.hook.desc: A hooked chain strikes the foe you look at for 4 damage and drags it to you. A boss is only staggered.
hero.skill.shield.iron_maiden.name: Iron Maiden
hero.skill.shield.iron_maiden.desc: An iron maiden closes on a foe held in your Shield Prison, after a short wind-up (a column of dust marks it). 16 damage, up to 20 with a full Counter, which it spends.
hero.skill.shield.needle_burst.name: Needle Burst
hero.skill.shield.needle_burst.desc: The Needle Shield's needles all at once: after a short gathering (lines of dust show the reach) every foe within 4.5 blocks takes 4 damage, up to 10 with a full Counter, and half of the Counter is spent.
hero.skill.shield.shooting_star.name: Shooting Star Shield
hero.skill.shield.shooting_star.desc: After a flash of light at the shield (a fifth of a second) a comet of glass flies about 22 blocks and strikes the first foe for 9 damage and a shove.
hero.skill.shield.soul_aegis.name: Soul Aegis
hero.skill.shield.soul_aegis.desc: The Soul Eater Shield gives the souls it has eaten (up to five, from your kills) as Absorption to you and the friends within 6 blocks for 12 seconds.
hero.skill.shield.undead_control.name: Undead Control
hero.skill.shield.undead_control.desc: The undead within 12 blocks lose their will to attack for 6 seconds, unless you strike them. A boss is not affected.
hero.skill.shield.absolute_defence.name: Absolute Defence
hero.skill.shield.absolute_defence.desc: Absolute Defence: for 5 seconds a dome of iron stands where you cast it. Friends inside take a great deal less damage (you most), foes are pushed out and shots are stopped, but you move slowly.
hero.skill.shield.rage_bash.name: Rage Bash
hero.skill.shield.rage_bash.desc: The Shield of Rage lunges up to 4 blocks and slams, for 10 damage and a burn to everything near the point of impact.
hero.skill.shield.rage_roar.name: Rage Roar
hero.skill.shield.rage_roar.desc: A roar shoves back the foes in front of you (4 damage, slowed) and fills you with strength for 6 seconds.
hero.skill.shield.blood_sacrifice.name: Blood Sacrifice
hero.skill.shield.blood_sacrifice.desc: Blood Sacrifice: a ring of blood is drawn under the foe you look at; a second later a trap of blood closes on everything in the ring: 18 damage to that foe, 8 to the others, and a short hold. You give a quarter of your health (never below 30 percent) only if it catches something, and then you are weakened and slowed for 15 seconds.
hero.skill.shield.megiddo.name: Megiddo Burst
hero.skill.shield.megiddo.desc: Megiddo Burst: after a long wind-up (a growing ring of dust where you stand) you give 30 percent of your health (never below a quarter) and fire burns everything within 9 blocks of that ring for 28 damage. You are left weakened.
hero.skill.sword.blitz.name: Blitz Strike
hero.skill.sword.blitz.desc: Blitz Strike: after a blink of warning (a line of blue dust) you dash up to 7 blocks and cut everything in the way for 8 damage. The next blow within 3 seconds leaves a ghost strike.
hero.skill.sword.tempest.name: Tempest Dance
hero.skill.sword.tempest.desc: Tempest Dance: two sweeps of the blade round you, 5 damage each to every foe within 4.5 blocks, shoving them back. A ring of dust marks the reach.
hero.skill.sword.afterimage.name: Afterimage Step
hero.skill.sword.afterimage.desc: Afterimage Step: you step 5 blocks the way you were moving (backwards if you stood still) and leave a double where you were. Faster for 3 seconds, a little tougher for 1, and your next blow leaves a ghost strike.
hero.skill.sword.flashing.name: Flashing Sword
hero.skill.sword.flashing.desc: Flashing Sword: the blade flashes in front of you. Foes in the cone take 4 damage and are lit up; mobs are blinded for 2 seconds (players are only slowed for 1). You run faster for 3 seconds.
hero.skill.sword.wind_cutter.name: Wind Cutter Whistle
hero.skill.sword.wind_cutter.desc: Wind Cutter Whistle: three whistling crescents of wind fly out in a fan to 12 blocks, 4 damage each, through everything they meet.
hero.skill.sword.meteor.name: Meteor Sword
hero.skill.sword.meteor.desc: Meteor Sword: after a moment (dust marks the ring) four stars fall in a ring where you point, 3 damage each to foes near them.
hero.skill.sword.assassin.name: Assassin Sword
hero.skill.sword.assassin.desc: Assassin Sword: you blink behind the foe you look at (up to 12 blocks) and stab it for 8 damage, 12 if it was not facing you.
hero.skill.sword.eagle_blade.name: Eagle Blade
hero.skill.sword.eagle_blade.desc: Eagle Blade: after a glint you lunge up to 5 blocks at the first foe in the line. The point goes through armour: 10 damage, up to 16 on heavy armour.
hero.skill.sword.gravity.name: Gravity Sword
hero.skill.sword.gravity.desc: Gravity Sword: the weight round the foe you look at grows for 3 pulses. Everything within 3.5 blocks of it is slowed, pulled to the ground and cut for 3 damage a pulse. A boss is held for one second at most.
hero.skill.sword.cleave.name: Skyfall Cleave
hero.skill.sword.cleave.desc: Skyfall Cleave: after a crouch (a ring of dust shows the landing) you leap 5 blocks and slam the blade down: 16 damage to everything within 3.5 blocks, thrown up and back.
hero.skill.sword.phoenix_gale.name: Phoenix Gale Blade
hero.skill.sword.phoenix_gale.desc: Phoenix Gale Blade: the sword gathers red energy for a moment, then a storm of flame burns the cone in front of you (9 damage) and a bird of fire flies on (9 more). Both set the foe alight.
hero.skill.sword.float_blades.name: Float Sword
hero.skill.sword.float_blades.desc: Float Sword: four swords circle you for 8 seconds. Once a second each of them cuts a different foe within 3.5 blocks (3 damage, 12 at most on one foe) and together they stop up to three shots.
hero.skill.sword.hundred_swords.name: Hundred Swords
hero.skill.sword.hundred_swords.desc: Hundred Swords: the blade splits into a hundred. After a moment (a ring of dust) they rain on the circle where you point, 4 damage a wave for four waves.
hero.skill.sword.lightning_hundred.name: Lightning Hundred Swords
hero.skill.sword.lightning_hundred.desc: Lightning Hundred Swords: a long gathering (a great ring of dust and a circle of light), then eight waves of lightning blades over the ground within 7 blocks of where you point, 3.6 damage a wave.
hero.skill.sword.guillotine.name: Guillotine
hero.skill.sword.guillotine.desc: Guillotine: a column of gold dust marks the spot where the foe stands; a moment later a great blade falls there for 16 damage and takes a share of the magicules of what it cuts. A foe that moves away is missed.
hero.skill.sword.gold_rebellion.name: Gold Rebellion
hero.skill.sword.gold_rebellion.desc: Gold Rebellion: a ring of golden blades cuts every foe within 5 blocks for 10 damage and gilds them for 6 seconds; your next blow on a gilded foe takes more.
hero.skill.sword.maneater.name: Maneater
hero.skill.sword.maneater.desc: Maneater: after a moment (the cone is marked) a maw closes on up to three foes in front of you for 14 damage each, and feeds you 4 percent of your health for each.
hero.skill.sword.strong_decline.name: Strong Decline
hero.skill.sword.strong_decline.desc: Strong Decline: a line of dust shows a split in the ground; a moment later it opens 10 blocks ahead, fangs rise from it and cut for 16 damage and slow what they catch.
hero.skill.sword.insatiable_maw.name: Insatiable Maw
hero.skill.sword.insatiable_maw.desc: Insatiable Maw: after a long wind-up (a banquet field and a ring of dust where you stand) three great maws close over everything within 7 blocks of that ring, 9.6 damage each, and each wave that bites feeds you 6 percent of your health.
hero.passive.shield.herb_regen.desc: While the fight is quiet (three seconds since the last blow) the Leaf Shield slowly mends its wielder.
hero.passive.shield.balloon_bounce.desc: The wielder takes no damage from falls.
hero.passive.shield.hatchling_guard.desc: The wielder's pets within 12 blocks regenerate.
hero.passive.shield.gel_absorb.desc: A quarter of every blow is soaked up by the gel, at most 8 percent of the wielder's health for one blow.
hero.passive.shield.rotting_endurance.de: Once a minute, a blow that would take the wielder under 30 percent of their health is answered with regeneration and a moment of toughness.
hero.passive.shield.venom_fang.desc: A mob that strikes the guard is poisoned for 4 seconds (not a player, not a boss).
hero.passive.shield.needle_counter.desc: A melee blow stopped by the guard is answered with needles: at most half the blow's strength, at most once per attacker every half second.
hero.passive.shield.bulwark.desc: The guard holds half as much again, and the parry window is wider.
hero.passive.shield.soul_eater.desc: Foes the wielder kills within 16 blocks leave souls (up to five) for Soul Aegis.
hero.passive.shield.drain_null.desc: The wielder cannot be withered or starved by effects.
hero.passive.shield.rage_fury.desc: Every blow the wielder takes fills them with strength for 4 seconds (stronger if hit again), and the damage the guard soaks becomes half as much Counter again.
hero.passive.sword.quick_draw.desc: The first blow after a pause of three seconds is an opening strike with 3 extra damage.
hero.passive.sword.wind_walker.desc: The speed that the Tempo earns comes one blow earlier, and falls hurt half as much.
hero.passive.sword.shadow_blade.desc: A blow from the back half of a foe adds 3 damage.
hero.passive.sword.star_shower.desc: Every fifth blow calls a star down on the foe: 4 damage to everything near it.
hero.passive.sword.gravity_edge.desc: Blows slow the foe (not a boss) for a second and a half.
hero.passive.sword.ember_edge.desc: Blows set the foe alight, and the wielder resists fire.
hero.passive.sword.carapace_guard.desc: Once every 15 seconds the carapace halves a blow that would take a fifth of the wielder's health.
hero.passive.sword.hundred_edge.desc: Every tenth blow rains blades on the foe: 3 damage to everything near it.
hero.passive.sword.thunder_edge.desc: A blow arcs lightning to a second foe within 5 blocks for 3 damage, at most once a second.
hero.passive.sword.plunder.desc: Blows take a sliver of the foe's magicules for the wielder.
hero.passive.sword.fang_maw.desc: Blows on a foe under 30 percent of its health bite for 3 more damage.
hero.skill.spear.piercing_thrust.name: Piercing Thrust
hero.skill.spear.piercing_thrust.desc: Thrusts along a straight line 8 blocks long: after a 3 tick glint every foe in the line, up to 6, takes 6 base damage. Walls stop it; step out of the line.
hero.skill.spear.lunge.name: Dragoon Lunge
hero.skill.spear.lunge.desc: Dashes up to 9 blocks forward, running through every foe in the way (up to 6) for 6 base damage. The dash stops at walls and never ends over a gap.
hero.skill.spear.vault.name: Pole Vault
hero.skill.spear.vault.desc: Plants the spear and vaults about 7 blocks forward and 2 to 3 up. Slow Falling for 3 seconds makes the landing soft.
hero.skill.spear.javelin.name: Javelin Throw
hero.skill.spear.javelin.desc: Hurls the spear after a 6 tick wind-up: it flies about 30 blocks and pierces up to 4 foes for 9 base damage each. Walls stop it.
hero.skill.spear.whirlwind.name: Windmill Sweep
hero.skill.spear.whirlwind.desc: Spins the long spear: after a 4 tick ring of wind every foe within 4.8 blocks (up to 12) takes 8 base damage and is thrown outward.
hero.skill.spear.riposte.name: Counter Thrust
hero.skill.spear.riposte.desc: Raises a counter stance for 1.2 seconds. The next blow you take is cut by 65% and, if the attacker is within 7 blocks, answered with a thrust for 7 base damage. Arrows and other projectiles are only halved.
hero.skill.spear.chaos_spear.name: Chaos Spear
hero.skill.spear.chaos_spear.desc: The spear splits into 5 lances that fly at the nearest foes you can see within 14 blocks: 2.4 base damage each, so 12 on a lone foe. Cover and distance stop them.
hero.skill.spear.hooked_pierce.name: Hooked Pierce
hero.skill.spear.hooked_pierce.desc: Spears the foe under the crosshair within 12 blocks for 5 base damage and hauls it to arm's length. A boss is not moved; you are pulled to it instead. Hard control: it shares the 12 second control lock.
hero.skill.spear.meteor_spear.name: Meteor Spear
hero.skill.spear.meteor_spear.desc: After a 10 tick glow the spear streaks 16 blocks like a falling star: up to 8 foes in the lane take 14 base damage, and the point where it ends bursts for 4 more within 2.5 blocks.
hero.skill.spear.portal_spear.name: Portal Spear
hero.skill.spear.portal_spear.desc: Opens a portal at the point you aim at within 24 blocks and steps through after 6 ticks, landing on solid ground within 3 blocks of it. Foes within 2.8 blocks of the exit take 4 base damage. Refused when there is no footing.
hero.skill.spear.filo_rush.name: Filo Rush
hero.skill.spear.filo_rush.desc: Runs like a filolial: Speed 3 for 2.5 seconds, and every foe you run into (up to 6) takes 5 base damage once and is knocked aside.
hero.skill.spear.triaina.name: Triaina
hero.skill.spear.triaina.desc: A beam of energy: after a 12 tick wind-up it runs 18 blocks, 1.4 wide, striking up to 10 foes for 14 base damage. Walls stop it.
hero.skill.spear.minute_hand.name: Minute Hand
hero.skill.spear.minute_hand.desc: After 8 ticks a hand of light 9 blocks long sweeps a full circle round you in 1.5 seconds; every foe it passes (up to 12) takes 16 base damage once. Break line of sight or turn with the hand to avoid it.
hero.skill.spear.brionac.name: Brionac
hero.skill.spear.brionac.desc: The spear's blazing light: a ring gathers for 1.2 seconds, then a beam 26 blocks long and 2.6 wide strikes up to 12 foes for 26 base damage and drives them back. Walls stop it; leave the line while the ring gathers.
hero.skill.spear.time_reversal.name: Time Reversal
hero.skill.spear.time_reversal.desc: Turns the minute hand back: you return to where you stood up to 8 seconds ago (the nearest safe place within 3 blocks), regain up to 25% of your maximum health if you were healthier then, and lose every harmful effect gained since. The world and other people are untouched.
hero.skill.spear.temptation.name: Temptation
hero.skill.spear.temptation.desc: A wave of allure: after 10 ticks foes within 9 blocks (up to 8) are drawn towards you for 1.2 seconds, and those who arrive take 6 base damage. Bosses are only slowed. Hard control: it shares the 12 second control lock.
hero.skill.spear.rapture.name: Rapture
hero.skill.spear.rapture.desc: Hunger for the nearest foe: a line fixes on it, and 6 ticks later you lunge up to 10 blocks at it, run it through for 10 base damage and drink 5% of your maximum health from it. It adds 12 corruption.
hero.skill.spear.thorn_chains.name: Thorn Chains
hero.skill.spear.thorn_chains.desc: Chains and thorns burst from the ground within 4 blocks of the point you aim at (up to 14 blocks away) and stay for 2 seconds: every 0.5 seconds foes inside take 2.4 base damage and are slowed. Step out of the ring.
hero.skill.spear.lusts_embrace.name: Lust's Embrace
hero.skill.spear.lusts_embrace.desc: Everything within 10 blocks (up to 12 foes) is dragged to you over 1 second, then the spear releases a crushing burst for 28 base damage. Bosses are struck but not moved. It adds 40 corruption.
hero.skill.bow.piercing_shot.name: Eagle Piercing Shot
hero.skill.bow.piercing_shot.desc: Your next full draw (90% or more) looses a sniper arrow of light that runs up to 64 blocks and pierces up to 6 foes for 14 base damage each. A thin line shows where it will fly, so everyone can see it coming. It stays ready for 10 seconds.
hero.skill.bow.net_arrow.name: Bind Arrow
hero.skill.bow.net_arrow.desc: Your next draw of 50% or more pins the first foe it hits to the ground for up to 1.5 seconds (5 base damage). Hard control: it shares the 12 second control lock, and a boss is only staggered. It stays ready for 10 seconds.
hero.skill.bow.mark_arrow.name: Marking Arrow
hero.skill.bow.mark_arrow.desc: Your next draw of 30% or more marks the first foe it hits for 8 seconds: it glows through walls and is left frail, so you and your friends hurt it more (3 base damage). It stays ready for 10 seconds.
hero.skill.bow.explosive_arrow.name: Burst Arrow
hero.skill.bow.explosive_arrow.desc: Your next draw of 50% or more looses an arrow that sticks in the first foe or wall within 40 blocks and bursts 0.5 seconds later: every foe within 3.5 blocks of it takes 10 base damage and is pushed back. The ring on the ground shows the fuse. It breaks no blocks.
hero.skill.bow.tracking_shot.name: Seeker Arrow
hero.skill.bow.tracking_shot.desc: Your next draw of 40% or more looses an arrow that homes in on the foe nearest your crosshair (within 35 degrees and 40 blocks) for 8 base damage. Walls stop it, and it flies for 2 seconds.
hero.skill.bow.second_arrow.name: Second Arrow
hero.skill.bow.second_arrow.desc: Your next draw of 50% or more looses two arrows; the second follows 0.5 seconds later at 60% power. Together they never do more than 12 base damage to one foe.
hero.skill.bow.arrow_rain.name: Arrow Rain
hero.skill.bow.arrow_rain.desc: You shoot into the sky; after 10 ticks arrows fall within 5 blocks of the point you aimed at (up to 40 blocks away), 6 waves 0.5 seconds apart, 2 base damage each wave. The circle is drawn on the ground.
hero.skill.bow.arrow_squall.name: Arrow Squall
hero.skill.bow.arrow_squall.desc: 7 arrows fly in a 40 degree fan up to 20 blocks after a 6 tick draw; each arrow that strikes a foe deals 1.7 base damage, so a close foe can take all 7. The fan is drawn first.
hero.skill.bow.bird_hunting.name: Bird Hunting
hero.skill.bow.bird_hunting.desc: 5 shafts lock onto the foe under your crosshair within 36 blocks and strike together after 6 ticks for 11 base damage. Breaking line of sight saves the foe.
hero.skill.bow.retreat_shot.name: Backstep Shot
hero.skill.bow.retreat_shot.desc: You spring up to 6 blocks backwards to safe ground and loose a quick arrow at the nearest foe in front of you for 5 base damage.
hero.skill.bow.meteor_bow.name: Meteor Bow
hero.skill.bow.meteor_bow.desc: A star falls where you aim (up to 48 blocks) after 1.2 seconds; the circle (4 blocks from its centre) is drawn on the ground. Foes inside take 16 base damage and are thrown back.
hero.skill.bow.frozen_rain.name: Frozen Rain
hero.skill.bow.frozen_rain.desc: An icy shower within 6 blocks of the point you aim at (up to 36 blocks away): 5 times, 0.5 seconds apart, foes inside take 2 base damage and are slowed.
hero.skill.bow.starfall_volley.name: Starfall Volley
hero.skill.bow.starfall_volley.desc: A storm of light arrows rises and falls within 8 blocks of the point you aim at (up to 40 blocks away): after 1 second, 8 waves 0.5 seconds apart, 3.25 base damage each wave to every foe inside.
hero.skill.bow.law_fanatic.name: Law Fanatic
hero.skill.bow.law_fanatic.desc: A sinister aura condenses into armour: Resistance and Speed for 10 seconds, and your plain arrows hit 15% harder.
hero.skill.bow.bull_of_phalaris.name: Bull of Phalaris
hero.skill.bow.bull_of_phalaris.desc: A brass bull closes round the foe under your crosshair (within 28 blocks): after 10 ticks it is held for up to 1.5 seconds and takes 10 base damage in the furnace. Hard control: a boss is only staggered.
hero.skill.bow.pride_command.name: Pride's Command
hero.skill.bow.pride_command.desc: Your next draw of 40% or more turns the first monster it hits against its own side: it takes 4 base damage and up to 3 monsters near it fight it for as long as their minds allow. Never a boss or a player. Hard control: it shares the 12 second control lock.
hero.skill.bow.autocracy_justice.name: Autocracy Justice
hero.skill.bow.autocracy_justice.desc: Orbs of light pour from the bow and form a lion that tears at everything within 7 blocks of the point you aim at (up to 36 blocks away): after 1 second, 4 waves for 7 base damage each. It adds 30 corruption.
hero.passive.spear.time_memory.desc: While the spear is in your hand it writes down where you stand, how healthy you are and which ills you carry, once a second, for the last 8 seconds. Time Reversal reads it back. The memory is dropped when the spear is put away, at logout and at death.
hero.passive.spear.featherlight.desc: You take no damage from falls while the spear is in your hand.
hero.passive.spear.longshaft.desc: The Piercing Thrust, the Meteor Spear and Triaina run 25 percent longer.
hero.passive.spear.kill_vigor.desc: A kill mends 2 percent of your maximum health.
hero.passive.spear.portal_echo.desc: Stepping out of a Portal Spear leaves a rush of speed (Speed II) for 3 seconds.
hero.passive.spear.lust_fervor.desc: Each blow of the spear adds 6 percent to your melee damage, up to 5 times (30 percent); the stacks last 6 seconds after the last blow.
hero.passive.spear.ravenous_aim.desc: Your thrusts, throws, lunge and beams turn towards the nearest foe in sight within 9 blocks and 75 degrees of where you look. Restraint is gone: you cannot aim away from prey.
hero.passive.bow.quickdraw.desc: The string draws a quarter faster: full power after 16 ticks instead of 20.
hero.passive.bow.farsight.desc: Plain arrows fly 30 percent farther, never past 64 blocks.
hero.passive.bow.piercing_arrows.desc: A plain arrow goes through the first foe and strikes a second one for 70 percent of its power.
hero.passive.bow.eagle_eye.desc: Plain arrows hit foes farther than 24 blocks 25 percent harder, never above the ordinary limit.
hero.passive.bow.pride_arrows.desc: Your arrows grow huge: 20 percent harder and as wide as a block.
hero.skill.hammer.overhead_smash.name: Overhead Smash
hero.skill.hammer.overhead_smash.desc: Raises the hammer and brings it down on the ground ahead; a ring shows where it lands. Heavy damage, a shove and a lot of poise to everything standing in it. Step out of the ring, or jump.
hero.skill.hammer.shockwave.name: Shockwave
hero.skill.hammer.shockwave.desc: Strikes the ground and sends a crack running ahead along it. A dotted line shows the path first. Hits everything on the ground along the line; whatever is in the air passes over it.
hero.skill.hammer.armor_crack.name: Armor Crack
hero.skill.hammer.armor_crack.desc: A short, hard blow on the foe you face. A ring marks it for a moment, then the hammer lands: heavy damage and a lot of poise, and the foe's armour is cracked for eight seconds.
hero.skill.hammer.quake_stomp.name: Quake Stomp
hero.skill.hammer.quake_stomp.desc: Plants the hammer and stamps: the ground heaves in a wide ring round you. A ring closes in first. Everything standing on the ground inside is hurt, thrown outward and loses poise; jump to avoid it.
hero.skill.hammer.skyward_smash.name: Skyward Smash
hero.skill.hammer.skyward_smash.desc: An upward blow on the foe you face that throws it into the air, out of reach of the ground blows, so a friend can strike it or you can break off. A boss is only nudged.
hero.skill.hammer.forge_aegis.name: Forge Aegis
hero.skill.hammer.forge_aegis.desc: Strikes the anvil of the world: you and your allies within seven blocks are tempered for eight seconds, taking less damage and gaining two hearts of absorption. It heals nothing.
hero.skill.hammer.titan_fall.name: Titan's Fall
hero.skill.hammer.titan_fall.desc: Leaps high with the hammer and comes down like a falling mountain. A ring follows you down to show where it will land. Huge damage and poise to everything in it, enough to break a golem. You take no fall damage.
hero.passive.hammer.heavy_blows.desc: Every blow of the hammer builds poise on the foe, more with the attack bar full. A foe whose poise fills breaks: slowed, weakened and easier to hurt for a moment, and it cannot be broken again for a while.
hero.passive.hammer.rubble.desc: A full swing throws stone chips at up to three foes beside the one struck, for a little damage and poise.
hero.passive.hammer.anvil_stance.desc: While you sneak with the hammer out, blows from other creatures land at 82 percent. Falls, fire and the void are not blunted.
hero.passive.hammer.crushing_weight.desc: Every third full swing cracks the armour of the foe struck for five seconds.
hero.passive.hammer.synthesis.desc: The canon power-up of the Vassal Hammer: this form keeps the signature effect of every form you have learned (Heavy Blows, Rubble, Anvil Stance, Crushing Weight), not only its own.
hero.skill.claw.air_strike_slash.name: Air Strike Slash
hero.skill.claw.air_strike_slash.desc: Slashes the air and sends a crescent flying ahead; it cuts up to three foes in its line and opens a wound on each. A foe that steps out of the line in time is missed. A Second Slash soon after is stronger.
hero.skill.claw.second_slash.name: Second Slash
hero.skill.claw.second_slash.desc: Two crossing cuts in a fan in front of you, a wound with each. Used within five seconds of an Air Strike Slash that found a foe it is the follow-up: it lunges, reaches farther and hits 40 percent harder.
hero.skill.claw.hemorrhage.name: Hemorrhage
hero.skill.claw.hemorrhage.desc: Tears open every wound on the foe you face at once. The burst is bigger the more wounds are open (up to five, seven with the Dragon Claws) and the wounds close. A foe that is not bleeding is not touched.
hero.skill.claw.pounce.name: Pounce
hero.skill.claw.pounce.desc: Leaps far forward and lands with the claws out: foes at the landing are cut and bleed twice over. You take no fall damage. With the Rope Claws the leap homes in on the foe you face.
hero.skill.claw.shredding_rush.name: Shredding Rush
hero.skill.claw.shredding_rush.desc: Rushes the foe you face and rakes it four times in a flurry. Each cut opens a wound and strips more of its armour (7 percent a cut, 28 percent after the fourth) for five seconds. If it gets away from you the flurry stops.
hero.skill.claw.predator_instinct.name: Predator's Instinct
hero.skill.claw.predator_instinct.desc: The beast in the gem wakes for eight seconds: you gain speed and haste, and every foe within twenty blocks that is bleeding glows, so you can find it through walls and in the dark.
hero.skill.claw.dragon_rend.name: Dragon Rend
hero.skill.claw.dragon_rend.desc: Marks a twelve-block line in front of you; a moment later you tear through everything in it in one run, then rake each foe twice more as you pass: three cuts and three wounds on up to eight foes. Needs foes in the path when you start; a foe that leaves the line in time is missed.
hero.skill.claw.wahnsinn_claw.name: Wahnsinn Claw
hero.skill.claw.wahnsinn_claw.desc: The cursed claw fires a beam of crimson light down a fourteen-block line after a short warning. Foes still in the line are hurt, cursed for eight seconds and cut with three wounds. It eats at your mind.
hero.passive.claw.rending_blows.desc: Every blow opens a wound that bleeds for six seconds, two wounds on a full swing. Wounds stack to five, and each bleeds a little every second.
hero.passive.claw.skill_mastery.desc: The canon power-up of the Vassal Claw: every technique grows with use through five levels, each worth 6 percent more damage and 4 percent less cooldown.
hero.passive.claw.scent_of_blood.desc: A blow on a foe that bears three or more wounds cuts once more.
hero.passive.claw.rope_hook.desc: The Pounce homes in on the foe you face, up to twelve blocks away.
hero.passive.claw.dragon_fangs.desc: Wounds stack to seven and stay open for eight seconds.
hero.passive.claw.madness.desc: The curse of the Cursed Claw: every blow opens one wound more, and the Wahnsinn Claw is yours at the price of corruption.
hero.skill.axe.crescent_break.name: Crescent Break
hero.skill.axe.crescent_break.desc: Sweeps the axe in a half circle in front of you: a green arc on the ground shows what it will cover, then every foe inside is cut and thrown back. Hits up to twelve.
hero.skill.axe.power_break.name: Power Break
hero.skill.axe.power_break.desc: A short overhead chop on the foe you face that breaks its strength: heavy damage, five seconds of weakness and three of slowness. A player behind a raised shield has the shield knocked down.
hero.skill.axe.tornado_axe.name: Tornado Axe
hero.skill.axe.tornado_axe.desc: Spins with the axe held out for a second: a green tornado grows round you and four times in a row everything within four blocks is cut and shoved, the last time hardest. You are slowed while it turns.
hero.skill.axe.mountain_break.name: Mountain Break
hero.skill.axe.mountain_break.desc: Brings the axe down and cuts a line twelve blocks long straight ahead. A dotted line shows the path first. Heavy damage to everything along it, on the ground or in the air.
hero.skill.axe.accelerator_smash.name: Accelerator Smash
hero.skill.axe.accelerator_smash.desc: Charges six blocks forward with the shoulder, hitting what is in the way, then smashes the ground where you stop. The smash hits everything within three blocks. Closes distance fast.
hero.skill.axe.axe_throw.name: Axe Throw
hero.skill.axe.axe_throw.desc: Hurls the axe fourteen blocks along your look; it cuts up to four foes on the way out, turns at the end and cuts again on the way back to your hand. A foe that steps out of the line in time is missed.
hero.skill.axe.guillotine.name: Guillotine
hero.skill.axe.guillotine.desc: A falling cut on the foe you face, with a red column over it as the warning. A foe at a quarter of its health or less (a player at a fifth) takes more than double; a boss is never executed. Kills feed Brawn.
hero.skill.axe.shine_axe_burst.name: Shine Axe Burst
hero.skill.axe.shine_axe_burst.desc: Needs five Brawn and spends all of it. The axe blazes: a pillar of green light rises over you, then everything within eight blocks is cut. Fourteen raw plus 2.2 for each Brawn spent, 31.6 at eight. You are held still while it gathers.
hero.skill.axe.cursed_penetration.name: Cursed Penetration
hero.skill.axe.cursed_penetration.desc: The Curse Axe drives through the foe you face: a raised shield is knocked down and a heavy cut lands, and a moment later the wound opens, a second cut. It costs you corruption.
hero.passive.axe.muscle_enhancement.desc: The canon power-up of the Vassal Axe. A full swing, a technique that hits and a kill build Brawn, up to eight: more melee damage, heavier techniques, harder to shove and a little faster. It is held for six seconds, then fades; Shine Axe Burst spends five or more.
hero.passive.axe.cleaving.desc: A full swing also cuts up to three foes standing beside the one struck.
hero.passive.axe.headsman.desc: A full swing on a foe an execution would take (a mob at a quarter of its health, a player at a fifth, never a boss) cuts once more.
hero.passive.axe.radiance.desc: Brawn fades half as fast, and the axe glows while you have six or more.
hero.passive.axe.self_repair.desc: The canon self-repair of the Curse Axe: it mends its wielder a little every two seconds, through the healing law.
hero.skill.whip.lash.name: Lash
hero.skill.whip.lash.desc: Cracks the whip along your look, seven blocks: it cuts up to three foes in the line and slows each for a second. With the Storm Whip the lash also charges the foe for the next Lightning Whip.
hero.skill.whip.bind_whip.name: Bind Whip
hero.skill.whip.bind_whip.desc: The whip coils round the foe you face like a living snake and holds it still for two seconds (a boss is only slowed). If your control is not ready it only slows. The foe is marked as bound.
hero.skill.whip.reel_in.name: Reel In
hero.skill.whip.reel_in.desc: Snares the foe you face from up to eleven blocks away and yanks it to you. Uses your control lock; a boss cannot be pulled. The foe is marked as bound, and arrives where your friends can strike it.
hero.skill.whip.tether_swing.name: Tether Swing
hero.skill.whip.tether_swing.desc: Throws the whip at the foe or the ledge you look at, up to sixteen blocks away, and swings yourself to it. You drift down softly afterwards. Nothing is pulled but you.
hero.skill.whip.lightning_whip.name: Lightning Whip
hero.skill.whip.lightning_whip.desc: Cracks the whip on the foe you face; after a short warning lightning jumps from it to the nearest foes, up to five, losing a fifth of its strength at each jump. A foe charged by the Storm Whip's lash takes 30 percent more.
hero.skill.whip.command.name: Command
hero.skill.whip.command.desc: The whip takes the power of monsters: up to three hostile monsters within fourteen blocks turn on the nearest other monster for six seconds, on violet strings from your hand. They never hurt you, your friends or any player. Not on bosses, creepers, ghasts or blazes. Uses your control lock.
hero.skill.whip.gigantic_star.name: Gigantic Star
hero.skill.whip.gigantic_star.desc: Whirls the spiked star on the end of the whip over your head and slams it down four and a half blocks ahead; a ring shows where. Heavy damage to everything within three blocks, a shove and a lift. A bound foe takes a quarter more with the Morning Star's Star Weight.
hero.skill.whip.portal_whip.name: Portal Whip
hero.skill.whip.portal_whip.desc: Cracks the whip into a gate of sand and steps through it up to fourteen blocks along your look, to a place with room to stand. Foes round where you arrive are lashed and slowed.
hero.skill.whip.dimension_whip.name: Dimension Whip
hero.skill.whip.dimension_whip.desc: The whip splits into countless lashes that reach every foe within eleven blocks at once, after a warning: each takes a heavy lash and is bound, as far as your control lock and the balance law allow. A boss is only slowed. You are held still while it gathers.
hero.passive.whip.coil.desc: A full swing, and every lash, leaves the foe slowed for a second.
hero.passive.whip.static_charge.desc: A lash or a full swing charges the foe for six seconds; the next Lightning Whip that reaches it deals 30 percent more.
hero.passive.whip.star_weight.desc: A bound foe takes a quarter more from the Gigantic Star.
hero.passive.whip.taskmaster.desc: The monsters you take with the Command are strengthened for as long as they obey.
hero.passive.whip.hourglass_flow.desc: The Tether Swing and the Portal Whip come back a fifth sooner.
hero.skill.staff.arcane_bolt.name: Arcane Bolt
hero.skill.staff.arcane_bolt.desc: A bolt of mana along your look line (24 blocks) that pierces 2 foes for 6 damage. A marked foe takes 15 percent more.
hero.skill.staff.chain_spark.name: Chain Spark
hero.skill.staff.chain_spark.desc: A spark leaps from the foe you aim at to up to 4 more within 7 blocks of each other, 5 damage each.
hero.skill.staff.rune_field.name: Rune Field
hero.skill.staff.rune_field.desc: Draws a rune circle (4 blocks) where you aim. After 1 s it pulses 3 times for 3.2 damage and slows whoever stands in it.
hero.skill.staff.arcane_burst.name: Arcane Burst
hero.skill.staff.arcane_burst.desc: A ring of force 5 blocks wide round you: 8 damage and a shove for every foe in it, a moment after the ring shows.
hero.skill.staff.magic_prism.name: Magic Prism
hero.skill.staff.magic_prism.desc: Hangs a prism where you aim for 8 s. An Arcane Bolt that passes through it splits into 3 more bolts at foes near the prism (3 splits).
hero.skill.staff.float_mirror.name: Float Mirror
hero.skill.staff.float_mirror.desc: A mirror floats before you for 4 s: shots flying at you are destroyed (up to 6) and up to 4 are sent back at their shooters for 3 damage.
hero.skill.staff.fenrir_rod.name: Fenrir Rod
hero.skill.staff.fenrir_rod.desc: Quickens your chant for 8 s: every staff spell you cast waits 35 percent less before it can be cast again.
hero.skill.staff.analyze.name: Analyze Magic
hero.skill.staff.analyze.desc: Marks up to 6 foes in front of you for 10 s. A marked foe takes 15 percent more from your staff spells.
hero.skill.staff.healing_light.name: Healing Light
hero.skill.staff.healing_light.desc: Heals you and allies within 7 blocks for 14 percent of their health and washes away one harmful effect each.
hero.skill.staff.bombardment.name: Perpetual Bombardment
hero.skill.staff.bombardment.desc: Marks a field 9 blocks wide where you aim. After 1.2 s 6 salvos of arcane bolts rain on it, 4.5 damage each.
hero.passive.staff.quick_chant.desc: Spells cast one after another (each within 4 s of the last) wait 5 percent less per earlier spell, up to 15 percent. A full staff swing keeps the chain going.
hero.passive.staff.sharp_focus.desc: Arcane Bolt deals 0.5 more damage and pierces one more foe.
hero.passive.staff.wide_prism.desc: Magic Prism lasts 4 s longer and splits a bolt into 4.
hero.passive.staff.deep_mirror.desc: Float Mirror lasts 2 s longer and can destroy 2 more shots.
hero.passive.staff.star_mark.desc: Marks from Analyze Magic last 5 s longer.
hero.skill.gauntlet.rush.name: Air Strike Rush
hero.skill.gauntlet.rush.desc: Lunge about 6 blocks along your look line and strike everything you pass through for 6 damage. Spends up to 3 skill points for 0.8 more damage each.
hero.skill.gauntlet.moonlight_kick.name: Moonlight Kick
hero.skill.gauntlet.moonlight_kick.desc: A rising crescent kick: the arc in front of you shows, and 0.2 s later every foe still in it takes 7 damage and a launch. Spends up to 2 skill points for 1 more damage each. A higher launch with each point.
hero.skill.gauntlet.afterimage_palm.name: Afterimage Palm
hero.skill.gauntlet.afterimage_palm.desc: Slip behind the nearest foe in front of you (up to 9 blocks), leaving an afterimage, and strike with an open palm for 8 damage that breaks a raised guard. Spends up to 3 skill points for 0.8 more damage each.
hero.skill.gauntlet.quaking_fist.name: Shaking Quaking Fist
hero.skill.gauntlet.quaking_fist.desc: Gather for a moment, then drive a shock along a line 7 blocks long: 7 damage, a shove and a slow. Spends up to 5 skill points for 0.7 more damage each.
hero.skill.gauntlet.tiger_leap.name: Tiger Leap
hero.skill.gauntlet.tiger_leap.desc: Leap about 7 blocks; where you come down the ground breaks for 7 damage and a shove within 3.2 blocks. Spends up to 3 skill points for 0.5 more damage each.
hero.skill.gauntlet.turtle_crush.name: Turtle Crush
hero.skill.gauntlet.turtle_crush.desc: Raise a heavy fist, then crush the ground in front of you (3.4 blocks): 14 damage that breaks guards and weakens. Spends up to 4 skill points for 1 more damage each.
hero.skill.gauntlet.iron_guard.name: Iron Guard
hero.skill.gauntlet.iron_guard.desc: Brace for 3 s: you take 40 percent less damage from blows and shots, every blow you take gives a skill point (up to 3) and the first one is answered with a counter of up to 5 damage.
hero.skill.gauntlet.second_wind.name: Second Wind
hero.skill.gauntlet.second_wind.desc: Breathe: heal 12 percent of your health, wash away one harmful effect and gain 3 skill points.
hero.skill.gauntlet.dragon_slayer.name: Dragon Slaying Conflagration Fist
hero.skill.gauntlet.dragon_slayer.desc: Needs 6 skill points and spends them all. After 1 s of blazing warning a fist of flame strikes the first foe in front of you (up to 7 blocks) for 20 damage, 2 more for each point beyond 6, and burns foes within 3.5 blocks of it for 10.
hero.passive.gauntlet.rank_points.desc: Blows, techniques and the hits your guard takes fill a pool of up to 10 skill points; the next technique spends them to hit harder. They fade after 5 idle seconds.
hero.passive.gauntlet.hardened_fist.desc: You take 8 percent less damage and a full swing gives one more skill point.
hero.passive.gauntlet.blossom_step.desc: Afterimage Palm and Tiger Leap can be used again 15 percent sooner.
hero.passive.gauntlet.spirit_bane.desc: Your techniques deal 1 more damage to undead foes.
hero.passive.gauntlet.dragon_heart.desc: The Conflagration Fist counts 1 skill point more than you hold: it opens at 5 and hits harder with the same pool.
hero.skill.projectile.instant_throw.name: Air Strike Throw
hero.skill.projectile.instant_throw.desc: Throw a blade along your look line (26 blocks) through up to 2 foes for 6 damage each. Every foe it hits is marked for 8 s.
hero.skill.projectile.boomerang.name: Returning Edge
hero.skill.projectile.boomerang.desc: The blade flies out 22 blocks, then comes back to you by a curved path, striking foes on both ways for 4 damage each time.
hero.skill.projectile.ricochet.name: Ricochet Throw
hero.skill.projectile.ricochet.desc: The blade hits the foe you aim at, or glances off a wall, and jumps to up to 3 more foes within 9 blocks of each other for 5 damage each.
hero.skill.projectile.knife_rain.name: Knife Rain
hero.skill.projectile.knife_rain.desc: One knife becomes 7, fanned over 36 degrees. The fan shows for 0.25 s, then each knife deals 3 damage to the first foe it meets (a foe takes at most 4).
hero.skill.projectile.tornado_throw.name: Tornado Throw
hero.skill.projectile.tornado_throw.desc: Three blades whirl round the foe you aim at, 4 damage each, and slow it.
hero.skill.projectile.bolas_blast.name: Bolas Blast
hero.skill.projectile.bolas_blast.desc: Bolas wrap the foe you aim at and slow it; after 1.2 s they burst in flame for 8 damage to everything within 3 blocks.
hero.skill.projectile.dritte_throw.name: Dritte Throw
hero.skill.projectile.dritte_throw.desc: Three blades in quick turn, each at a different foe in front of you (the same one if there is only one), 4 damage each.
hero.skill.projectile.recall.name: Recall Blades
hero.skill.projectile.recall.desc: Every marked foe within 28 blocks is struck by a blade that flies back to you, 5 damage each (up to 6). The marks are used up.
hero.skill.projectile.shadow_bind.name: Shadow Bind
hero.skill.projectile.shadow_bind.desc: Pin the foe you aim at by throwing a blade into its shadow: it cannot move for about 2.5 s (less on a player or a boss, and only once in a while).
hero.skill.projectile.thousand_blades.de: Marks a field 10 blocks wide where you aim. After 1.2 s blades pour down on it in 8 volleys, 4 damage each.
hero.passive.projectile.mark_prey.desc: Every foe your blades or your knife hit is marked for 8 s; Recall Blades strikes the marked.
hero.passive.projectile.second_throw.des: Air Strike Throw throws a second blade 0.3 s after the first.
hero.passive.projectile.wide_ricochet.de: Ricochet Throw jumps to one more foe and 2 blocks farther each time.
hero.passive.projectile.heavy_hatchet.de: Bolas Blast bursts 1 block wider and Tornado Throw slows its foe 2 s longer.
hero.passive.projectile.over_custom.desc: Every technique can be used again 10 percent sooner, the customisation paid for with coin.
hero.skill.carriage.call.name: Call the Carriage
hero.skill.carriage.call.desc: Calls your carriage 3.2 blocks in front of you and seats you in it (if it is already out it is brought to you). Used while you drive it, the carriage is sent away. It also leaves when you put the weapon away or stay off it for 10 s. Only one carriage at a time.
hero.skill.carriage.boost.name: Gallop Boost
hero.skill.carriage.boost.desc: While you drive: the carriage runs 80 percent faster for 2.5 s and the first blow on each foe it runs into deals 8 damage and a shove.
hero.skill.carriage.drift_ram.name: Drift Ram
hero.skill.carriage.drift_ram.desc: While you drive: a ring shows round the carriage, then it sweeps everything within 4 blocks for 7 damage, a shove and a slow.
hero.skill.carriage.comfort.name: Soothing Ride
hero.skill.carriage.comfort.desc: Heals everyone on the carriage, the carriage itself and every ally within 6 blocks of it (or of you), 6 at most, for 12 percent of their health and washes away one harmful effect each.
hero.skill.carriage.cabin_barrier.name: Cabin Barrier
hero.skill.carriage.cabin_barrier.desc: For 5 s everyone aboard takes less damage (resistance) and the carriage itself cannot be hurt.
hero.skill.carriage.haikuikku.name: Haikuikku
hero.skill.carriage.haikuikku.desc: A surge of speed for 8 s: the people aboard run faster and, while you drive, the carriage is 25 percent faster still. On foot it hastens you and the allies beside you.
hero.skill.carriage.waypoint.name: Mark Waypoint
hero.skill.carriage.waypoint.desc: Saves the place you stand on as the waypoint of your carriage (one at a time; the Portal Gate goes there).
hero.skill.carriage.portal.name: Portal Gate
hero.skill.carriage.portal.desc: Opens a gate at the carriage and at the waypoint; after 3 s the carriage and everyone aboard cross and sit down again. Same dimension, between 16 and 1000 blocks. Needs a clear place for the carriage at the waypoint.
hero.skill.carriage.crash_charge.name: Crash! Charge!
hero.skill.carriage.crash_charge.desc: While you drive: after 0.8 s of warning the carriage charges for 2.2 s at 2.3 times its speed. Each foe it crashes into takes 14 damage and a shove, the first is stunned for 1 s, and a moment later every foe near it is stomped for 8.
hero.passive.carriage.roomy_cabin.desc: The carriage seats 3 people instead of 2.
hero.passive.carriage.armoured_frame.des: The carriage has 90 health instead of 40.
hero.passive.carriage.queens_pull.desc: The carriage is 30 percent faster, as if the Filolial Queen drew it.
hero.skill.fan.flower_wind.name: Flower Wind
hero.skill.fan.flower_wind.desc: A wide sweep of cutting wind and petals: up to 8 foes within 5.5 blocks in front take 5 damage and are nudged back, and a sweep that cuts two or more gathers magic residue. Counter: stay out of the arc.
hero.skill.fan.moon_break.name: Moon Break
hero.skill.fan.moon_break.desc: Flings a crescent of wind 14 blocks forward that cuts up to 6 foes in its path for 8 damage. Counter: step aside; walls stop it.
hero.skill.fan.repel_gust.name: Repelling Gust
hero.skill.fan.repel_gust.desc: A ring of wind pushes every foe within 5 blocks away and turns arrows back on their archers. It deals no damage. Heavy foes barely move.
hero.skill.fan.gale_pull.name: Gale Pull
hero.skill.fan.gale_pull.desc: Draws up to 8 foes in front of you toward a point just ahead (heavy foes less). It is hard control, so it shares the 12 second control rest, and bosses are not pulled. Counter: stay beyond 9 blocks.
hero.skill.fan.wind_dance.name: Wind Dance
hero.skill.fan.wind_dance.desc: A gliding dash of about 6 blocks that brushes aside foes in the way for 4 damage; slow falling follows for 4 seconds.
hero.skill.fan.mist_veil.name: Mist Veil
hero.skill.fan.mist_veil.desc: Wraps you in mist for 4 seconds: mobs hunting you lose their target and you turn invisible. Attacking ends the veil. Foes right beside you still notice you.
hero.skill.fan.snow_plum.name: Snow Plum
hero.skill.fan.snow_plum.desc: Plum blossoms bless you and your friends within 8 blocks: speed for 8 seconds and a small heal (never more than 25 percent of their health).
hero.skill.fan.tortoise_shell_cracker.de: The wind coils at the fan tip, then a thrust cracks the foe on your crosshair for 10 damage plus half its armour (up to 8 more). Counter: leave its line of sight or raise a shield.
Ultimate. After a gathering of red petals a tornado of petals stands where you aim for 3 seconds and cuts foes inside it 6 times; every residue stack burns for more damage. Counter: leave the red circle.
hero.passive.fan.featherfall.desc: The fan's wind cushions you: falls hurt 60 percent less, and holding sneak while you fall lets you glide down slowly.
hero.passive.fan.residue.desc: The fan drinks the magic that leaks from foes: a kill, a sweep that cuts two or more, and every 4 full swings each add a stack (up to 6) that the petal tornado burns. Putting the fan away loses them.
hero.passive.fan.dragon_surge.desc: At 6 residue the sweep of Flower Wind reaches 1.5 blocks farther and cuts for 2 more.
hero.passive.fan.sealing_tide.desc: The gust and the pull of this sealing fan reach 1.5 blocks farther.
hero.passive.fan.tiger_pounce.desc: Wind Dance carries you a quarter faster.
hero.passive.fan.keystone_ward.desc: While the Mist Veil holds, projectiles hurt you 40 percent less.
hero.skill.scythe.full_moon_army.name: Full Moon Army
hero.skill.scythe.full_moon_army.desc: A full circle with the long scythe: up to 12 foes within 4.8 blocks take 6 damage and are nudged away. Counter: keep beyond 4.8 blocks.
hero.skill.scythe.flying_circle.name: Flying Circle
hero.skill.scythe.flying_circle.desc: Throws a spinning disc of energy 16 blocks forward; it cuts up to 6 foes for 5 damage on the way out and returns to cut them for 5 more. Counter: step out of its line.
hero.skill.scythe.wind_slice.name: Wind Slice
hero.skill.scythe.wind_slice.desc: A whirling cut in front of you: up to 8 foes within 4.8 blocks take 4 damage and are pushed back hard. It makes room when you are crowded.
hero.skill.scythe.reap.name: Soul Reap
hero.skill.scythe.reap.desc: After a short swing-up the scythe reaps a cone 6 blocks long for 10 damage; a mob at or under 30 percent health (never a boss or a player) takes double. Each foe it kills heals you 3 percent, at most 12 percent. Counter: leave the cone during the swing-up.
hero.skill.scythe.protection_break.name: Protection Break
hero.skill.scythe.protection_break.desc: After a short gathering a spirit-edged chop hits the foe on your crosshair for 9 damage plus 0.6 per point of its armour (up to 8 more). Counter: sidestep it or raise a shield.
hero.skill.scythe.deadly_dance.name: Deadly Dance
hero.skill.scythe.deadly_dance.desc: 4 swings in a row in front of you, each cutting foes within 4.6 blocks for 3 damage (12 in all). Counter: leave the arc.
hero.skill.scythe.floating_scythe.name: Floating Scythe
hero.skill.scythe.floating_scythe.desc: A second scythe floats at your side for 6 seconds and cuts the nearest foe within 5.5 blocks for 3 damage every second. You cannot conjure another while it floats.
hero.skill.scythe.soul_harvest.name: Soul Harvest
hero.skill.scythe.soul_harvest.desc: Ultimate. Souls gather round you for a moment, then a huge reaping circle of 7.5 blocks cuts every foe for 16 damage plus 1 per soul collected, 20 percent more on the weak, and heals you 2 percent per foe reaped. Counter: leave the circle.
hero.skill.scythe.scythe_zero.name: Scythe 0
hero.skill.scythe.scythe_zero.desc: A cut that deals no damage: it severs the beneficial effects (speed, strength, regeneration and the like) from up to 8 foes in front of you. Counter: none, it only takes.
hero.passive.scythe.soul_tithe.desc: Every kill with the scythe in hand gathers a soul (up to 10) that fades 120 seconds after the last one; Soul Harvest spends them. Putting the scythe away loses them.
hero.passive.scythe.dragon_soul.desc: The scythe can hold up to 14 souls.
hero.passive.scythe.null_edge.desc: A melee hit strips one beneficial effect from the foe; the same foe is not stripped again for 2 seconds.
hero.skill.katana.crescent_moon.name: Crescent Moon Sword
hero.skill.katana.crescent_moon.desc: A long thin slash: a crescent of light cuts up to 5 foes in a line 9 blocks long for 6.5 damage, a little more with tempo. Counter: step out of the line.
hero.skill.katana.instant_blade.name: Instant Blade: Mist
hero.skill.katana.instant_blade.desc: Iaido. After a breath (a glint at your hip) you dash up to 7 blocks and cut everything on the line for 9 damage, a little more with tempo. Counter: leave the line during the breath.
hero.skill.katana.counter_stance.name: Counter Stance
hero.skill.katana.counter_stance.desc: Raises a parry for 0.7 seconds: the first blow from a living foe is stopped (at most 60 percent of your health) and answered with a cut for 4 to 12 damage, and your tempo jumps to full. Counter: it stops one blow, so wait it out.
hero.skill.katana.release_evade.name: Release Evade
hero.skill.katana.release_evade.desc: A flick of the sword and a step away from the nearest foe: for 0.4 seconds the next blow from a living foe misses you, and your tempo rises. Counter: attacks that arrive after the step.
hero.skill.katana.triple_thrust.name: Triple Thrust
hero.skill.katana.triple_thrust.desc: After a short draw you step forward and thrust 3 times along a line 4.8 blocks long, 5 damage each, a little more with tempo. Counter: sidestep during the draw.
hero.skill.katana.stardust_blade.name: Stardust Blade
hero.skill.katana.stardust_blade.desc: 5 quick cuts in a flurry on the foe on your crosshair within 8 blocks, 2.4 damage each (12 in all), with stardust where the blade lands. Counter: get out of reach.
hero.skill.katana.double_sword.name: Double Sword
hero.skill.katana.double_sword.desc: A phantom second blade follows yours for 6 seconds: your next 4 melee hits are each doubled by a phantom cut for 2.5 damage.
hero.skill.katana.soul_slice.name: Soul Slice
hero.skill.katana.soul_slice.desc: A cut that goes through the body to the spirit: 8 damage and 4 percent of the foe's magicules drained; you take back 50 percent of it, at most 1.5 percent of your own. Foes without magicules lose nothing.
hero.skill.katana.sakura_dance.name: Kagura Dance of Sakura
hero.skill.katana.sakura_dance.desc: Ultimate. Three formations in a row (blossom, beginning blossom and a final line), together 18 damage plus 4 for every level of tempo you hold (up to 30 in all); the tempo is spent. Counter: leave the circle, then the cone, then the line.
hero.passive.katana.iai_tempo.desc: Using different katana techniques one after another, each within 4 seconds of the last, builds tempo (up to 3): every level adds damage to the cuts and thrusts and the dance of sakura grows with it.
hero.passive.katana.keen_opening.desc: The first full swing after 4 seconds without a katana action strikes again for 3 damage, as a draw cut should.
hero.passive.katana.riposte.desc: After a successful parry the next full swing within 3 seconds is followed by a riposte for 3 damage.
hero.skill.book.read_composition.name: Read Composition
hero.skill.book.read_composition.desc: Reads the next page of the offence chapter, in order: a Bird of Flame (6 damage along a line of 14 blocks), a Needle Rain (4 volleys of 2.5 on a circle of 3 blocks) and, with the Feather page, a beam of 9 damage. A page that finds no target is not read.
hero.skill.book.read_verse.name: Read Verse
hero.skill.book.read_verse.desc: Reads the next page of the support chapter, in order: a Paper Wall (absorption for you and friends within 5 blocks), a Healing Verse (3 pulses, together at most 25 percent of a friend's health) and, with the Binding page, a Constriction.
hero.skill.book.turn_page.name: Turn the Page
hero.skill.book.turn_page.desc: Turns past the next page of the chapter you read last without reading it, so another page comes up. A skipped page is still unread, so the volume is not complete until it is read.
hero.skill.book.paper_burst.name: Paper Splits Rock
hero.skill.book.paper_burst.desc: The page you aim at lights up (a ring shows where) and 8 ticks later explodes: foes within 3.5 blocks take 9 damage and are pushed away. Counter: leave the ring.
hero.skill.book.life_force_burst.name: Life Force Burst
hero.skill.book.life_force_burst.desc: Pages wrap the foe on your crosshair; if it stays within 6 blocks of where it was wrapped for 1.2 seconds, the trapped life force bursts for 14 damage. Counter: run before the burst.
hero.skill.book.constriction.name: Constriction
hero.skill.book.constriction.desc: Pages close into a cage round the foe on your crosshair (within 14 blocks): it is rooted for up to 2 seconds, then needles fall through the False Ceiling for 6 damage. It is hard control and shares the 12 second control rest.
hero.skill.book.libraria.name: Libraria
hero.skill.book.libraria.desc: Ultimate. Needs a complete volume (every page of both chapters read). The room turns white and in 8 volleys birds of fire, lightning, boulders and beams fall on every foe within 9 blocks for 3.5 damage each (28 in all). Counter: leave the white room.
hero.passive.book.chapters.desc: The book holds two chapters read in order: use reads the offence chapter, sneak and use the support chapter. Reading every page of both completes the volume and opens Libraria.
hero.passive.book.deck_feathers.desc: Adds the Feather Volley to the offence chapter: a beam of 12 blocks for 9 damage that mends you a little.
hero.passive.book.deck_cage.desc: Adds the Constriction to the support chapter.
hero.passive.book.revised_edition.desc: Every page and burst is 25 percent stronger, within the limits of its kind.
hero.passive.book.grand_library.desc: Libraria falls in 10 volleys, and the volume needs all but one page.
hero.skill.mirror.mirror_bash.name: Mirror Bash
hero.skill.mirror.mirror_bash.desc: Strike with the edge of the glass: a short cone, 3.6 blocks, that hurts for 6, shoves and staggers with a brief slowing. Every foe struck adds a little to the gleam. Needs a foe in reach.
hero.skill.mirror.glass_shield.name: Glass Shield
hero.skill.mirror.glass_shield.desc: Stand a pane of glass in the air ahead for 6 seconds. It turns three hostile shots back at their shooters and stores their light as gleam. When spent or out of time it bursts into shards that cut the foes near it for 4. Two panes stand at most; a third pushes the oldest out.
hero.skill.mirror.prism_ray.name: Prism Ray
hero.skill.mirror.prism_ray.desc: After a short, visible charge (a bright line shows the path) a beam of refracted light, 22 blocks long. It hurts for 7, and for up to 13 with a full gleam, which it spends. If it passes a standing pane it bounces off and strikes another foe for four fifths of that.
hero.skill.mirror.stardust_mirror.name: Stardust Mirror
hero.skill.mirror.stardust_mirror.desc: A barrier of star-glass round the ally you look at, or round you and the people beside you (three at most): Absorption for 8 seconds, and the next two hostile shots aimed at each of them are turned back.
hero.skill.mirror.release_rebound.name: Release Rebound
hero.skill.mirror.release_rebound.desc: For 4 seconds half of every spell that strikes you is turned back on its caster, at most 12 a blow and 20 in all. Two harmful effects are cleansed from you, and the plain damaging ones are sent on to the nearest foe for 6 seconds. Every reflected spell adds to the gleam.
hero.skill.mirror.movement_mirror.name: Movement Mirror
hero.skill.mirror.movement_mirror.desc: Step through the glass up to 9 blocks the way you look, leaving a silent image where you stood for 12 seconds. The image soaks one creature's blow, up to 35 percent of your health. Cast again while it stands to step back into its place.
hero.skill.mirror.chain_binding.name: Chain Binding Mirror
hero.skill.mirror.chain_binding.desc: Chains link your standing glass, panes and image, and bind up to 4 foes within 5 blocks of it for 3 seconds. Needs a Glass Shield or an image standing. Shared control lock.
hero.skill.mirror.kaleidoscope.name: Kaleidoscope
hero.skill.mirror.kaleidoscope.desc: A ring of six panes round the ground you aim at, up to 18 blocks away. After a short, visible tell, six pulses of light, one every 0.6 seconds, strike every foe inside the ring for 5 each. Leave the ring to answer it.
hero.skill.mirror.covet.name: Covet
hero.skill.mirror.covet.desc: Envy. Copy up to three of a foe's helpful effects onto yourself for up to 10 seconds, at most level III; the foe keeps theirs. Costs extra magicules and 35 corruption.
hero.skill.mirror.ressentiment.name: Ressentiment
hero.skill.mirror.ressentiment.desc: Envy. For 4 seconds the creatures within 9 blocks, six at most, turn on each other. No bosses, no players, and it needs two. Shared control lock. 40 corruption.
hero.skill.instrument.music_strike.name: Music Strike
hero.skill.instrument.music_strike.desc: Shoot a note like an arrow, up to 24 blocks. With no harmony it strays by up to 6 degrees; keep the beat and it flies true. It hits for 6, half a point more with each harmony.
hero.skill.instrument.demons_melody.name: Demon's Melody
hero.skill.instrument.demons_melody.desc: Seven notes in a fan, up to 14 blocks. The fan narrows as the harmony builds. Each note that strikes does 3, and one foe takes at most three of them.
hero.skill.instrument.stun_beat.name: Stun Beat
hero.skill.instrument.stun_beat.desc: A guitar note that flies to where you look and bursts in a flash of light. Foes within 3.5 blocks take 6 and, behind the shared control lock, are stunned for 2 seconds and dazzled for 1.
hero.skill.instrument.march.name: March
hero.skill.instrument.march.desc: A song that follows you for 10 seconds, longer with harmony. Allies within 10 blocks move and work faster: Speed I, and Speed II from harmony 3.
hero.skill.instrument.war_song.name: War Song
hero.skill.instrument.war_song.desc: A song that follows you for 8 seconds, longer with harmony. Allies within 10 blocks hit harder (Strength I) and, from harmony 3, take less damage (Resistance I).
hero.skill.instrument.lullaby.name: Lullaby
hero.skill.instrument.lullaby.desc: A drowsy tune: the foes within 9 blocks are slowed (level III) and weakened for up to 6 seconds, less on players and bosses. Shared control lock.
hero.skill.instrument.dirge.name: Dirge
hero.skill.instrument.dirge.desc: A funeral tune: the foes within 9 blocks are poisoned and weakened for 6 seconds, 8 from harmony 3. Poison never kills a player.
The tune of the grilled-fish instrument: allies within 8 blocks eat a little and mend a tenth of their health. It does nothing for those who are full and unhurt.
hero.skill.instrument.zero_note.name: Zero Note
hero.skill.instrument.zero_note.desc: A silent note, no damage: every ally within 8 blocks is freed of two harmful effects and of a sealed grimoire.
hero.skill.instrument.crescendo.name: Crescendo
hero.skill.instrument.crescendo.desc: Needs harmony 3 and spends the whole phrase. After a long breath (a ring on the ground shows its reach) the song swells for six pulses, 0.6 seconds apart: foes within 10 blocks take 4 each and are slowed, allies mend a fortieth of their health each time.
hero.skill.harpoon.harpoon_throw.name: Harpoon Throw
hero.skill.harpoon.harpoon_throw.desc: Skewer the first foe you look at, up to 18 blocks, for 7 and tie the line to it for 8 seconds. One creature is tied at a time, and the other techniques act on it. With Storm Charged the lightning arcs to one more foe beside it for 3.
hero.skill.harpoon.reel_in.name: Reel In
hero.skill.harpoon.reel_in.desc: Pull the tied creature to you, or, if it is heavy or a boss, pull yourself to it. It strikes for 4 on arrival. Shared control lock.
hero.skill.harpoon.lightning_strike_drag: Charge up to 8 blocks wreathed in lightning, hitting what is on the way for 7; after a breath turn and charge back the same way for 5.
hero.skill.harpoon.whale_hunting_harpoon: After a short, visible gathering (a ring and a column of light stand on the target) one great throw on the tied creature, or the one you look at: 14, a quarter more against a body with 40 health or more. It slams the target down and staggers it (shared control lock).
hero.skill.harpoon.crucifixion.name: Crucifixion
hero.skill.harpoon.crucifixion.desc: Pin the tied creature for 3 seconds under a cross of lightning that burns it three times for 4. Shared control lock.
hero.skill.harpoon.lightning_shock_harpo: Send lightning down the line: the tied creature is shocked for 7 and the current jumps to up to three foes within 6 blocks of it for 4 each.
hero.skill.harpoon.harpoon_zero.name: Harpoon 0
hero.skill.harpoon.harpoon_zero.desc: The 0 series: no damage. Strip up to three helpful effects from the tied or aimed creature, and one from each of up to three foes beside it.
hero.skill.harpoon.brave_fish_blaster.de: After a long, visible gathering (a line shows the path) a surge of lightning-charged water in the shape of a great fish, 20 blocks long: everything in it takes 16 and is staggered (shared control lock).
hero.skill.sewing_set.needle_shot.name: Needle Shot
hero.skill.sewing_set.needle_shot.desc: Three needles in a narrow fan, 20 blocks. Each needle that strikes does 3 and leaves a stitch mark in the foe for 8 seconds. With nothing struck, the middle needle marks the ally you look at (a beacon for 20 seconds) or plants itself in the ground.
hero.skill.sewing_set.bind_wire.name: Bind Wire
hero.skill.sewing_set.bind_wire.desc: Silk binds the foe you look at fast for 3 seconds and seals its skills for that long (a creature is silenced where Tensura has the effect). It hurts for 3 and leaves a stitch mark. Shared control lock.
hero.skill.sewing_set.jumping_needle.des: Jump, up to 48 blocks, to the nearest ally you have put a needle in, or to the needle planted in the ground. With neither, plant a needle where you stand.
hero.skill.sewing_set.stitch_mend.name: Stitch Mend
hero.skill.sewing_set.stitch_mend.desc: Close wounds with silk: four allies at most, those within 6 blocks and those you have put a needle in even 30 blocks away, mend 8 percent of their health and shed one harmful effect.
hero.skill.sewing_set.scissor_cut.name: Scissor Cut
hero.skill.sewing_set.scissor_cut.desc: Two great snips crossed on the spot you look at, up to 10 blocks away, after a short, visible crossing of lines. Foes within 3 blocks take 10, 30 percent more if they carry a stitch mark, which the snip uses up. It also snips you free of slowness.
hero.skill.sewing_set.stitched_barrier.d: A seam of stitches across the ground ahead, 9 blocks wide, for 6 seconds. It catches up to six hostile shots, and foes that touch it are slowed and pricked once for 3.
hero.skill.sewing_set.spider_net.name: Spider Net
hero.skill.sewing_set.spider_net.desc: A net of silk flung where you look, up to 14 blocks: up to three foes within 2.8 blocks of the target are held almost fast for up to 4 seconds, pricked for 4 and marked. Shared control lock.
hero.skill.sewing_set.ariadnes_thread.de: After a visible gathering of threads, up to four allies within 40 blocks, the ones with a needle in them first, then your party and pets, are drawn to your side, and every foe within 24 blocks is lit up for 8 seconds.
hero.skill.chain.chain_lash.name: Chain Lash
hero.skill.chain.chain_lash.desc: A lash of the chain along your look direction, 7 blocks: it hurts everything it crosses for 6, four foes at most, and tugs the far ones towards you.
hero.skill.chain.chain_pull.name: Chain Pull
hero.skill.chain.chain_pull.desc: Hook the first foe in sight, up to 16 blocks, and yank it to you; it strikes for 4 on arrival. A boss barely moves. Shared control lock.
hero.skill.chain.chain_binding.name: Chain Binding
hero.skill.chain.chain_binding.desc: Chains coil round one foe, up to 14 blocks away, and hold it fast for 3 seconds, hurting it for 3. Shared control lock.
hero.skill.chain.hydra.name: Hydra
hero.skill.chain.hydra.desc: After a short, visible gathering the chain is slammed down and five chains race out along the floor in a fan, 10 blocks long. A foe in any of them is struck once for 7 and popped up.
hero.skill.chain.chain_defence.name: Chain Defence
hero.skill.chain.chain_defence.desc: Chains wrap you and up to three people within 4 blocks: Absorption and Resistance I for 6 seconds.
hero.skill.chain.grapple.name: Grapple
hero.skill.chain.grapple.desc: Hook the first foe in sight, up to 20 blocks, and swing yourself to it, striking it for 6 where you land.
hero.skill.chain.orochi.name: Multi-Headed Orochi
hero.skill.chain.orochi.desc: Four groups of chains fall on the ground you aim at, up to 18 blocks away, after a visible tell. Up to four foes inside the 6-block ring are bound for up to 4 seconds and squeezed twice for 8 each, 1.5 seconds apart. Shared control lock.
hero.skill.chain.sloth_weight.name: Sloth: Weight
hero.skill.chain.sloth_weight.desc: Sloth. The foes within 8 blocks grow heavy: slowed and weakened for up to 6 seconds (shared control lock). You are slowed a little too. 30 corruption.
hero.skill.chain.sloth_snap.name: Sloth: Snap
hero.skill.chain.sloth_snap.desc: Sloth. A chain wraps the foe you look at now and slows it, behind the control lock; 3 seconds later it snaps tight for 12 if the foe is still within 18 blocks. 35 corruption.
hero.skill.chain.debt_comes_due.name: The Bill Comes Due
hero.skill.chain.debt_comes_due.desc: Sloth. For 6 seconds heavy chains lie round you: the foes within 9 blocks are slowed and tired for up to 6 seconds (shared control lock, taken once), and so are you. Then the whole bill comes due on every foe within 11 blocks: one great blow of 16 and a stagger. 120 corruption.
hero.passive.mirror.spell_ward.desc: While the mirror is in your hand the magic damage you take is cut by 15 percent.
hero.passive.mirror.afterimage.desc: Your image repeats your next Mirror Bash or Prism Ray once, 0.6 seconds later and at half strength, and then dissolves.
hero.passive.instrument.perfect_pitch.de: Your notes never stray: the Music Strike flies true and the Demon's Melody fan stays narrow, even with no harmony.
hero.passive.instrument.fairy_choir.desc: Songs and tunes reach a quarter farther.
hero.passive.instrument.steady_beat.desc: The pocket in which the next technique counts as in time is a second wider, so harmony is easier to build.
hero.passive.harpoon.barbed_head.desc: A melee blow on the creature the line is tied to keeps the line alive 2 seconds longer, to 12 seconds after the throw at most.
hero.passive.harpoon.storm_charged.desc: The lightning of the throw arcs to one more foe beside the target.
hero.passive.sewing_set.fine_stitch.desc: A stitch mark in a foe lasts 4 seconds longer.
hero.passive.chain.heavy_links.desc: Every blow of the chain hangs a link on what it strikes. At the third blow in a row, each within 3 seconds of the last, the weight takes hold and the creature is slowed for 2 seconds.

nusmp.skill.ft_fire_dragons_iron_fist.de: A flaming punch at the foes in front of you. They burn. (Skill Tree: Fire Dragon Slayer.)
nusmp.skill.ft_fire_dragons_roar.descrip: Draw a breath, then roar a lane of fire down the way you look. (Skill Tree: Fire Dragon Slayer.)
nusmp.skill.ft_fire_dragons_claw.descrip: A flaming kick that hops you forward and launches the foes in front of you. (Skill Tree: Fire Dragon Slayer.)
nusmp.skill.ft_fire_dragons_brilliant_fl: Throw a great fireball at what you aim at; it bursts where it lands. (Skill Tree: Fire Dragon Slayer.)
Both arms sweep out like wings of flame and throw back what stands before you. (Skill Tree: Fire Dragon Slayer.)
nusmp.skill.ft_fire_dragons_sword_horn.d: Charge head first through the foes ahead of you, wreathed in flame. (Skill Tree: Fire Dragon Slayer.)
nusmp.skill.ft_crimson_lotus_exploding_f: Secret Art. A spiral of flame barrages the lane before you, and a great explosion ends it. (Skill Tree: Fire Dragon Slayer.)
nusmp.skill.ft_lightning_dragons_iron_fi: A lightning punch at the foes in front of you. The shock numbs and arcs on to others. (Skill Tree: Lightning Dragon Slayer.)
nusmp.skill.ft_lightning_dragons_roar.de: Draw a breath, then roar a fan of lightning that numbs what it touches. (Skill Tree: Lightning Dragon Slayer.)
nusmp.skill.ft_lightning_dragons_breakdo: Fire an enormous lightning fist from a magic seal at the first foe in line. (Skill Tree: Lightning Dragon Slayer.)
nusmp.skill.ft_lightning_dragons_heavenw: Hurl a great spear of lightning down a long lane, piercing everything in it. (Skill Tree: Lightning Dragon Slayer.)
nusmp.skill.ft_thunder_palace.descriptio: Hang orbs of lightning over the spot you aim at; they loose bolts onto the area below. (Skill Tree: Lightning Dragon Slayer.)
nusmp.skill.ft_lightning_dragons_jaw.des: Clasp both hands and slam lightning down in front of you, throwing foes outward. (Skill Tree: Lightning Dragon Slayer.)
nusmp.skill.ft_lightning_dragons_flash.d: Streak forward as lightning, shocking the foes you pass through. (Skill Tree: Lightning Dragon Slayer.)
nusmp.skill.ft_roaring_thunder.descripti: Secret Art. Rush at a foe, then release a vast arching burst of lightning from your fist. (Skill Tree: Lightning Dragon Slayer.)
nusmp.skill.ft_sky_dragons_roar.descript: Breathe a tornado-like blast in a cone: foes in front are hurt and shoved back. From level 4 the wind also mends allies standing in it. (Skill Tree: Sky Dragon Slayer.)
nusmp.skill.ft_sky_dragons_wing_attack.d: Spin a whirlwind from both arms: every foe close to you is cut and thrown outward. (Skill Tree: Sky Dragon Slayer.)
nusmp.skill.ft_sky_dragons_wave_wind.des: Sweep a hand to loose a great tornado that walks forward, shredding and slowing what it crosses, and lingers where it stops. (Skill Tree: Sky Dragon Slayer.)
nusmp.skill.ft_sky_dragons_breath.descri: Healing gusts mend the most wounded allies around you first; you gain only part of it yourself. (Skill Tree: Sky Dragon Slayer.)
nusmp.skill.ft_sky_troia.description: A ball of soft light that restores balance: it strips nausea, poison and other ills from the allies around you. (Skill Tree: Sky Dragon Slayer.)
nusmp.skill.ft_sky_arms_vernier.descript: Allies around you hit harder and run faster for a while; the top level chants the spell twice. (Skill Tree: Sky Dragon Slayer.)
nusmp.skill.ft_sky_drill.description: Secret Art. A wall of wind closes round you and your foes, squeezes in and drills; allies inside are mended, then the wall bursts and flings the foes skyward. (Skill Tree: Sky Dragon Slayer.)
nusmp.skill.ft_ice_make_lance.descriptio: Loose long ice spears down the way you look; they pierce everything in a line and chill it. At higher levels the spears fan out. (Skill Tree: Ice-Make.)
nusmp.skill.ft_ice_make_floor.descriptio: Freeze the ground where you look for a few seconds: foes on it slow and chill, you and your friends glide faster. (Skill Tree: Ice-Make.)
nusmp.skill.ft_ice_make_shield.descripti: Raise a wall of ice in front of you that swallows every arrow and spell thrown across it from outside your party, and wraps you in frost-hardened health. (Skill Tree: Ice-Make.)
nusmp.skill.ft_ice_make_cannon.descripti: Build a small ice cannon that fires by itself at the nearest foe it can see for a few seconds. (Skill Tree: Ice-Make.)
nusmp.skill.ft_ice_make_saucer.descripti: Throw a spinning disc of ice that cuts through everything in its path. From level 3 it returns to you, cutting again. (Skill Tree: Ice-Make.)
nusmp.skill.ft_ice_make_eagle.descriptio: Shape ice eagles that fly at different foes, dodging whatever is in between; no foe takes more than two. (Skill Tree: Ice-Make.)
nusmp.skill.ft_ice_make_hammer.descripti: A great ice hammer forms above the foe you aim at, hangs where you can see it coming, and falls with crushing force. (Skill Tree: Ice-Make.)
nusmp.skill.ft_ice_make_excalibur.descri: Secret Art. Forge a gigantic ice longsword, show its arc, and cut it in one huge sweep that chills everything it hits. (Skill Tree: Ice-Make.)

message.nusmp.mega.dnd.frightful: A True Dragon's pressure crushes the hall. %1$s failed the save.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.lair_tremor: The hall shudders. Get off the floor!
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.lair_light: Searing light gathers at a hero's feet. Move!
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.lair_stars: Stars fall around you. Watch the rings!
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.lair_mist: A necrotic mist rolls over the floor. Leave it.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.haki: The dragon's pressure rolls over you. %1$s failed the save.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.breath: It draws breath... %1$s! Get out of the ring!
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.mind_blast: A psychic wave rolls out. %1$s failed the save.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.death_touch: Death Touch marks %1$s. Step out of the circle!
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.lair_field: An anti-magic field blooms. Your magicules drain inside it.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.exec_cast: Word of Ending: %1$s is named. Heal, break line of sight, or break its concentration!
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.exec_mark: WORD OF ENDING - heal above 35 %, break sight, or hurt the boss hard!
nusmp.skill.hk_provoke.description: Roar a challenge: hostile creatures near you turn on you, and you gain a short Resistance. (Skill Tree: Oath of the Heavy Armor.)
nusmp.skill.hk_shield_wall.description: Plant yourself: strong Resistance and Absorption for a few seconds. (Skill Tree: Oath of the Heavy Armor.)
nusmp.skill.hk_shield_bash.description: Slam your shield into everyone in front of you: they are hurt, shoved back and slowed. (Skill Tree: Oath of the Heavy Armor.)
nusmp.skill.hk_power_strike.description: One heavy blow at the foe in front of you. (Skill Tree: Basic Swordsmanship.)
nusmp.skill.hk_swift_step.description: A quick dash forward with a breath of Resistance. (Skill Tree: Basic Swordsmanship.)
nusmp.skill.hk_crescent_cut.description: A wide sweeping cut through everyone in front of you. (Skill Tree: Basic Swordsmanship.)
nusmp.skill.hk_gamblers_coin.description: Flip a coin: heads gives Luck, Speed and Regeneration, tails a little Regeneration. Your Luck tilts the coin. (Skill Tree: Lady Luck.)
nusmp.skill.hk_jackpot.description: Secret Art. Pull the lever and the world pays out emeralds and experience; Luck makes the pot deeper. (Skill Tree: Lady Luck.)
