mechanic.nusmp.floor.eclipse_dark.name: The Eclipse Dark
mechanic.nusmp.floor.eclipse_dark.desc: The lamps gutter and die in a wide ring round the delvers, and the dark that follows is thick enough to bite.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.eclipse_dark.flavor: Even the torches seemed to turn their faces away.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.eclipse_dark.e_hush: The lamps gutter and die in a wide ring round the delvers, and the dark that follows is thick enough to bite. Nothing but the dark: no darkness potion, only the lamps gone.
Even the torches seemed to turn their faces away.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.eclipse_dark.t_dark: The lamps gutter and die in a wide ring round the delvers, and the dark that follows is thick enough to bite. It thrives where the light is low and strikes the delver who lingers in the dark.
Even the torches seemed to turn their faces away.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.eclipse_dark.c_hold: The lamps gutter and die in a wide ring round the delvers, and the dark that follows is thick enough to bite. Carry a light through it long enough and it relents.

mechanic.nusmp.floor.weeping_sky.name: The Weeping Sky
mechanic.nusmp.floor.weeping_sky.desc: A cold, endless rain falls on everyone who walks the floor, quiet and unhurried, and the water seems to remember every bad day.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.weeping_sky.flavor: The rain does not hurry. It has centuries.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.weeping_sky.e_storm: A cold, endless rain falls on everyone who walks the floor, quiet and unhurried, and the water seems to remember every bad day. The rain turns to a storm, and bolts walk the floor.
The rain does not hurry. It has centuries.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.weeping_sky.t_timer: A cold, endless rain falls on everyone who walks the floor, quiet and unhurried, and the water seems to remember every bad day. It runs on a timer for as long as anyone stays.
The rain does not hurry. It has centuries.

mechanic.nusmp.floor.red_gate_magma.desc: In the red dungeons the ground itself turns against the hunters: patches of floor go to glowing magma under their feet, for a while, on a timer.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.red_gate_magma.flav: The floor lit up, and the hunters ran.

mechanic.nusmp.floor.rukh_current.desc: The birds of fate flow through the corridors as a visible current: those who walk with it are mended, those who stand against it are chilled.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.rukh_current.flavor: Everything that lives is carried by the Rukh, and returns to it.

mechanic.nusmp.floor.wild_surge.desc: The raw magic of the floor goes off at random: each surge picks one wild effect, and nobody, the floor included, knows which.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.wild_surge.flavor: Roll the die. Tell the table what you meant to do.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.wild_surge.e_kind.d: The raw magic of the floor goes off at random: each surge picks one wild effect, and nobody, the floor included, knows which. A kinder table: the surge draws only the gifts, a heal and a shield of luck.

mechanic.nusmp.floor.meshi_hunger.name: The Hunger of the Depths
mechanic.nusmp.floor.meshi_hunger.desc: Everything on this floor is a little bit hungry, and so are you: the stomach gnaws faster the deeper the floor, and only a proper meal puts it right.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.meshi_hunger.flavor: Eat the monster. It is only polite.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.meshi_hunger.e_cook: The Hunger of the Depths: Cook's Hunger

Everything on this floor is a little bit hungry, and so are you: the stomach gnaws faster the deeper the floor, and only a proper meal puts it right. Hunger bites, but it also bargains: a smell of stew restores a share of health with each wave.
Eat the monster. It is only polite.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.meshi_hunger.t_spri: The Hunger of the Depths: Footfall

mechanic.nusmp.floor.aura_pressure.name: Pressure of the Heavy Aura
mechanic.nusmp.floor.aura_pressure.desc: A hunter's aura, vast and unfriendly, lies over the whole floor: it presses on the shoulders and sets the knees shaking, more so with every pack the delver carries.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.aura_pressure.flavo: Kneel. Or don't, and watch what happens.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.aura_pressure.e_har: Pressure of the Heavy Aura: Crushing Aura

mechanic.nusmp.floor.listening_walls.des: The dungeon hears everything: running boots and jumping feet wake whatever sleeps close by, and a quiet party is a safe one.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.listening_walls.fla: Quiet. Even the goblins are listening.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.listening_walls.e_g: The dungeon hears everything: running boots and jumping feet wake whatever sleeps close by, and a quiet party is a safe one. What answers is a small band of goblin-like raiders, not insects.

mechanic.nusmp.floor.anti_magic_fog.flav: A world with no magic left in it.

mechanic.nusmp.puzzle.door_of_teeth.t_fl: A great stone mouth is the only door, and it opens for blood: the more it is fed, the wider it grins, and it is not shy about asking again. It strikes once, the moment the area is first entered.
mechanic.nusmp.puzzle.door_of_teeth.c_pa: A great stone mouth is the only door, and it opens for blood: the more it is fed, the wider it grins, and it is not shy about asking again. Pay a few levels of experience at the altar to end it.
mechanic.nusmp.puzzle.door_of_teeth.e_hu: The Door of Teeth: The Hungry Mouth

mechanic.nusmp.puzzle.door_of_teeth.t_pr: A great stone mouth is the only door, and it opens for blood: the more it is fed, the wider it grins, and it is not shy about asking again. It springs when someone comes within a few blocks of its heart.

mechanic.nusmp.puzzle.test_of_position.f: A Regular must find the right place. A Wave Controller makes sure it's the wrong one.
mechanic.nusmp.puzzle.test_of_position.e: The Test of Position: Test of Pairs
A test floor of the Tower: the party is told where to stand, and the answer is as much about who stands with whom as about the spot. A test for two: two plates and two delvers who trust each other.

mechanic.nusmp.puzzle.zodiac_gates.name: The Zodiac Gates
mechanic.nusmp.puzzle.zodiac_gates.desc: Twelve keys of the sky hang in the wall and six gates must be opened in the right order, each one a spirit who answers only the call of its own sign.
mechanic.nusmp.puzzle.zodiac_gates.e_thr: The Zodiac Gates: The Three Gates
Twelve keys of the sky hang in the wall and six gates must be opened in the right order, each one a spirit who answers only the call of its own sign. Only three gates today: a smaller test.

mechanic.nusmp.puzzle.zodiac_gates.e_sto: The Zodiac Gates: Gates in a Storm

mechanic.nusmp.puzzle.weeping_statues.de: A hall of statues that move whenever the delvers' eyes are elsewhere: they close in silently, and only holding their stony gaze keeps them still.
mechanic.nusmp.puzzle.weeping_statues.e_: The Statues That Move: Statues of Stone
A hall of statues that move whenever the delvers' eyes are elsewhere: they close in silently, and only holding their stony gaze keeps them still. Statues of heavier stone: tougher and slower.

mechanic.nusmp.puzzle.tarokka_spread.des: Three cards are laid on the table in a gypsy's pavilion and the room asks the delvers to lay them in the order the cards say; the cards, being what they are, show different orders to different eyes.
mechanic.nusmp.puzzle.tarokka_spread.fla: The cards do not lie. They merely arrange.
mechanic.nusmp.puzzle.tarokka_spread.e_f: The Tarokka Spread: The Five-Card Spread

Three cards are laid on the table in a gypsy's pavilion and the room asks the delvers to lay them in the order the cards say; the cards, being what they are, show different orders to different eyes. A five-card spread, longer and meaner.
The cards do not lie. They merely arrange.

mechanic.nusmp.puzzle.tarokka_spread.e_c: The Tarokka Spread: The Cursed Reading

mechanic.nusmp.hazard.needle_lock.name: The Poisoned Needle Lock
mechanic.nusmp.hazard.needle_lock.desc: A handsome lock on a chest-like block that bites back: a hair-fine needle in the keyhole, a drop of something green, and a delver who learns about both through the finger.
mechanic.nusmp.hazard.needle_lock.flavor: It was the cleverest lock in the world, right up to the moment you touched it.
mechanic.nusmp.hazard.needle_lock.e_slee: The Poisoned Needle Lock: Sleeping Needle

A handsome lock on a chest-like block that bites back: a hair-fine needle in the keyhole, a drop of something green, and a delver who learns about both through the finger. The poison is a sleeping draught: slowness, then a heavy drowsiness.

mechanic.nusmp.hazard.flooding_vault.fla: Seven feet of water in a ten-foot room. Take a deep breath.
mechanic.nusmp.hazard.flooding_vault.e_s: The Flooding Vault: The Slow Drain

mechanic.nusmp.hazard.fire_jets.flavor: Mind the gaps between the flames.

mechanic.nusmp.hazard.crushing_ceiling.f: In the third room of the tomb, the ceiling got lower. You noticed too late.

mechanic.nusmp.hazard.poison_gas_room.fl: The vents are older than the walls.

mechanic.nusmp.hazard.explosive_tags.e_l: Paper tags pasted along the wall in a pattern: stand on the wrong square and the whole line flares one after another, each blast setting off the next. Tags of lightning, not fire: a crack on each.
mechanic.nusmp.hazard.explosive_tags.t_s: Paper tags pasted along the wall in a pattern: stand on the wrong square and the whole line flares one after another, each blast setting off the next. Running in its area sets it off.
mechanic.nusmp.hazard.explosive_tags.c_s: Paper tags pasted along the wall in a pattern: stand on the wrong square and the whole line flares one after another, each blast setting off the next. Sneak through its area long enough and it loses interest.
mechanic.nusmp.hazard.explosive_tags.e_s: Paper tags pasted along the wall in a pattern: stand on the wrong square and the whole line flares one after another, each blast setting off the next. Smoke tags: they blind and confuse instead of exploding.
mechanic.nusmp.hazard.explosive_tags.t_s: Paper tags pasted along the wall in a pattern: stand on the wrong square and the whole line flares one after another, each blast setting off the next. It wakes when someone looks straight at it.
mechanic.nusmp.hazard.wire_trap.name: The Assassin's Wire
mechanic.nusmp.hazard.wire_trap.desc: A thread of Teigu steel strung ankle high across the hall, invisible until it is far too late: the unwary come to a violent, sliding stop, and then the pursuers step in.
mechanic.nusmp.hazard.wire_trap.flavor: The thread cuts before you see it.
mechanic.nusmp.hazard.wire_trap.e_webs.d: A thread of Teigu steel strung ankle high across the hall, invisible until it is far too late: the unwary come to a violent, sliding stop, and then the pursuers step in. A thread of spider silk instead: webs and a slow, sticky delay.

mechanic.nusmp.hazard.wire_trap.t_jump.d: A thread of Teigu steel strung ankle high across the hall, invisible until it is far too late: the unwary come to a violent, sliding stop, and then the pursuers step in. Jumping in its area sets it off.

mechanic.nusmp.hazard.thorn_garden.name: The Thorn Garden
mechanic.nusmp.hazard.thorn_garden.desc: A garden of beautiful flowers that eat what steps on them: thorns reach out of the floor in a creeping lace, and what they touch goes numb.
mechanic.nusmp.hazard.thorn_garden.flavo: Everything beautiful on this island wants you dead.
mechanic.nusmp.hazard.thorn_garden.e_fir: A garden of beautiful flowers that eat what steps on them: thorns reach out of the floor in a creeping lace, and what they touch goes numb. The thorns burn.
Everything beautiful on this island wants you dead.
mechanic.nusmp.hazard.thorn_garden.t_tim: A garden of beautiful flowers that eat what steps on them: thorns reach out of the floor in a creeping lace, and what they touch goes numb. It runs on a timer for as long as anyone stays.
Everything beautiful on this island wants you dead.

Everything beautiful on this island wants you dead.

mechanic.nusmp.hazard.bomb_devil.name: The Bomb Devil's Gift
mechanic.nusmp.hazard.bomb_devil.desc: A devil's present left on the floor: a ticking thing in a bright wrapper, a cheerful countdown, and a bang much larger than the room.
mechanic.nusmp.hazard.bomb_devil.e_clust: The Bomb Devil's Gift: A Cluster of Gifts

mechanic.nusmp.hazard.bomb_devil.c_sneak: A devil's present left on the floor: a ticking thing in a bright wrapper, a cheerful countdown, and a bang much larger than the room. Sneak through its area long enough and it loses interest.
mechanic.nusmp.hazard.bomb_devil.e_dud.n: The Bomb Devil's Gift: A Dud
mechanic.nusmp.hazard.bomb_devil.e_dud.d: A devil's present left on the floor: a ticking thing in a bright wrapper, a cheerful countdown, and a bang much larger than the room. A dud that fizzles with a cloud of smoke: no damage, but the smoke blinds.
mechanic.nusmp.hazard.bomb_devil.t_sprin: A devil's present left on the floor: a ticking thing in a bright wrapper, a cheerful countdown, and a bang much larger than the room. Running in its area sets it off.

mechanic.nusmp.hazard.gravity_sink.name: The Gravity Sink
mechanic.nusmp.hazard.gravity_sink.desc: A pocket of the floor is far heavier than it has any right to be: everything near it is dragged down, then slung out sideways when the sink lets go.
mechanic.nusmp.hazard.gravity_sink.flavo: A little piece of the abyss, installed at floor level.
The Gravity Sink: The Gravity Spout
A pocket of the floor is far heavier than it has any right to be: everything near it is dragged down, then slung out sideways when the sink lets go. The pocket pushes everything up and away.

mechanic.nusmp.combat.leader_first.name: Kill the Shaman First
mechanic.nusmp.combat.leader_first.desc: A band of raiders is held together by a shaman in their midst: while the shaman lives the others shrug off most blows, so the fight is won by whoever picks the right target.
mechanic.nusmp.combat.leader_first.e_str: Kill the Shaman First: The Iron Shaman

A band of raiders is held together by a shaman in their midst: while the shaman lives the others shrug off most blows, so the fight is won by whoever picks the right target. The tether is nearly total: 95 per cent of every blow on a follower is turned aside.

mechanic.nusmp.combat.shield_switch.desc: The room's guardians are inside a barrier no blade can pierce, and somewhere in the room a switch holds the key: the party that finds it first and pulls it wins the fight before it starts.
mechanic.nusmp.combat.shield_switch.flav: You have to read the room before you can swing at it.

mechanic.nusmp.combat.spell_turning.flav: The more you hurt it, the more it hurts you.

mechanic.nusmp.combat.wall_waves.flavor: The wall has stood for a hundred years. Today we will see why.

mechanic.nusmp.combat.turf_war_spill.des: Two monster factions have been fighting over this chamber and the party stumbles into their quarrel: every kill draws a response from the rival band, and the Dungeon Master takes an interest.
mechanic.nusmp.combat.turf_war_spill.fla: In a monster nation, even the squabbles are politics.
mechanic.nusmp.combat.turf_war_spill.e_u: The Turf War Spills Over: The Undead Quarrel

Two monster factions have been fighting over this chamber and the party stumbles into their quarrel: every kill draws a response from the rival band, and the Dungeon Master takes an interest. The quarrel is among the dead.
In a monster nation, even the squabbles are politics.

mechanic.nusmp.combat.dungeon_ambush.des: A quiet room with nobody in it, until the door closes: the monsters were waiting in the dark on all sides, for as long as it took the delvers to wander in.
mechanic.nusmp.combat.dungeon_ambush.fla: Surprise round. Roll for initiative. Not that you needed to.
mechanic.nusmp.combat.dungeon_ambush.e_b: A quiet room with nobody in it, until the door closes: the monsters were waiting in the dark on all sides, for as long as it took the delvers to wander in. The ambushers are knights of the road.
Surprise round. Roll for initiative. Not that you needed to.
mechanic.nusmp.combat.dungeon_ambush.t_f: A quiet room with nobody in it, until the door closes: the monsters were waiting in the dark on all sides, for as long as it took the delvers to wander in. It strikes once, the moment the area is first entered.

mechanic.nusmp.combat.dungeon_ambush.c_s: A quiet room with nobody in it, until the door closes: the monsters were waiting in the dark on all sides, for as long as it took the delvers to wander in. Last out the time and it ends by itself.
Surprise round. Roll for initiative. Not that you needed to.
mechanic.nusmp.combat.dungeon_ambush.e_w: A quiet room with nobody in it, until the door closes: the monsters were waiting in the dark on all sides, for as long as it took the delvers to wander in. The ambushers drop out of the ceiling on silk.
Surprise round. Roll for initiative. Not that you needed to.

Surprise round. Roll for initiative. Not that you needed to.

mechanic.nusmp.combat.gel_splitting.name: The Splitting Gel
mechanic.nusmp.combat.gel_splitting.desc: A great gelatinous thing and the knowledge that every blow that kills it makes two smaller ones: the smart party fights with fire and patience, the other with a sword.
mechanic.nusmp.combat.gel_splitting.flav: Never feed a slime after midnight, they said.
mechanic.nusmp.combat.gel_splitting.e_th: The Splitting Gel: The Three-Way Split
A great gelatinous thing and the knowledge that every blow that kills it makes two smaller ones: the smart party fights with fire and patience, the other with a sword. Three smaller ones each time.
Never feed a slime after midnight, they said.
mechanic.nusmp.combat.gel_splitting.t_fl: A great gelatinous thing and the knowledge that every blow that kills it makes two smaller ones: the smart party fights with fire and patience, the other with a sword. It strikes once, the moment the area is first entered.
Never feed a slime after midnight, they said.
mechanic.nusmp.combat.gel_splitting.c_ki: A great gelatinous thing and the knowledge that every blow that kills it makes two smaller ones: the smart party fights with fire and patience, the other with a sword. One marked warden holds it up; slay the keystone to end it.
Never feed a slime after midnight, they said.
mechanic.nusmp.combat.gel_splitting.e_ac: The Splitting Gel: The Acid Gel

A great gelatinous thing and the knowledge that every blow that kills it makes two smaller ones: the smart party fights with fire and patience, the other with a sword. The gel is acid: contact wears down the party.
Never feed a slime after midnight, they said.
mechanic.nusmp.combat.gel_splitting.t_ki: A great gelatinous thing and the knowledge that every blow that kills it makes two smaller ones: the smart party fights with fire and patience, the other with a sword. It answers the dungeon's deaths: every few kills in the area set it off.
Never feed a slime after midnight, they said.
mechanic.nusmp.combat.wounded_prey.name: The Frenzy of Wounded Prey
mechanic.nusmp.combat.wounded_prey.desc: The things in this room can smell weakness: let a delver drop below half health and the whole pack goes wild, faster and harder, until someone stops the bleeding.
mechanic.nusmp.combat.wounded_prey.e_hea: The Frenzy of Wounded Prey: The Hunters' Feast

The things in this room can smell weakness: let a delver drop below half health and the whole pack goes wild, faster and harder, until someone stops the bleeding. The pack also recovers a third of its health.
mechanic.nusmp.combat.wounded_prey.t_flo: The Frenzy of Wounded Prey: Omen

The things in this room can smell weakness: let a delver drop below half health and the whole pack goes wild, faster and harder, until someone stops the bleeding. It strikes once, the moment the area is first entered.

mechanic.nusmp.combat.wounded_prey.e_fea: The Frenzy of Wounded Prey: Frightening Frenzy

mechanic.nusmp.combat.wounded_prey.t_dam: The Frenzy of Wounded Prey: Backlash

mechanic.nusmp.combat.homunculus_core.de: The enemies here stitch themselves back together as fast as they are torn apart: somewhere in each is a red core, and while it holds, they live.
mechanic.nusmp.combat.homunculus_core.fl: A body is only a vessel. Break the stone.
mechanic.nusmp.combat.homunculus_core.e_: The Homunculus Core: The Fast Regeneration
The enemies here stitch themselves back together as fast as they are torn apart: somewhere in each is a red core, and while it holds, they live. Even faster: a fifth restored each time.
A body is only a vessel. Break the stone.
mechanic.nusmp.combat.homunculus_core.t_: The enemies here stitch themselves back together as fast as they are torn apart: somewhere in each is a red core, and while it holds, they live. It strikes every time someone steps back into the area.
A body is only a vessel. Break the stone.
mechanic.nusmp.combat.homunculus_core.c_: The enemies here stitch themselves back together as fast as they are torn apart: somewhere in each is a red core, and while it holds, they live. It is held up by wardens that spawn with it; kill them all to end it.
A body is only a vessel. Break the stone.
mechanic.nusmp.combat.homunculus_core.e_: The Homunculus Core: The Many Cores
The enemies here stitch themselves back together as fast as they are torn apart: somewhere in each is a red core, and while it holds, they live. Each regeneration also calls a servant.
A body is only a vessel. Break the stone.
mechanic.nusmp.combat.homunculus_core.t_: The enemies here stitch themselves back together as fast as they are torn apart: somewhere in each is a red core, and while it holds, they live. It answers every real wound dealt in its area.
A body is only a vessel. Break the stone.
mechanic.nusmp.combat.gate_guardian.name: The Gate Guardian
mechanic.nusmp.combat.gate_guardian.desc: A gate boss waits in front of the dungeon's door, an elite knight with a retinue: the guardian only moves when the hunters step into its line.
mechanic.nusmp.combat.gate_guardian.flav: A-rank gates have always had a boss.
mechanic.nusmp.combat.gate_guardian.e_tw: A gate boss waits in front of the dungeon's door, an elite knight with a retinue: the guardian only moves when the hunters step into its line. Two elites in place of one.
A-rank gates have always had a boss.
mechanic.nusmp.combat.gate_guardian.t_fl: A gate boss waits in front of the dungeon's door, an elite knight with a retinue: the guardian only moves when the hunters step into its line. It strikes once, the moment the area is first entered.
A-rank gates have always had a boss.
mechanic.nusmp.combat.gate_guardian.c_ki: A gate boss waits in front of the dungeon's door, an elite knight with a retinue: the guardian only moves when the hunters step into its line. It is held up by wardens that spawn with it; kill them all to end it.
A-rank gates have always had a boss.
mechanic.nusmp.combat.gate_guardian.e_ar: The Gate Guardian: The Iron Guardian
A gate boss waits in front of the dungeon's door, an elite knight with a retinue: the guardian only moves when the hunters step into its line. A heavier guardian, plated against wounds.
A-rank gates have always had a boss.
mechanic.nusmp.combat.gate_guardian.t_si: A gate boss waits in front of the dungeon's door, an elite knight with a retinue: the guardian only moves when the hunters step into its line. It wakes when someone looks straight at it.
A-rank gates have always had a boss.
mechanic.nusmp.combat.nen_hunt.name: The Nen Beast Hunt
mechanic.nusmp.combat.nen_hunt.desc: A conjured beast has marked one of the delvers and hunts that scent through the room; the others see the glow and are told, with some glee, to keep the marked one alive.
mechanic.nusmp.combat.nen_hunt.flavor: The target is not the strongest. The target is the one who showed fear.
mechanic.nusmp.combat.nen_hunt.e_link.na: The Nen Beast Hunt: Chain of Binding
mechanic.nusmp.combat.nen_hunt.e_link.de: A conjured beast has marked one of the delvers and hunts that scent through the room; the others see the glow and are told, with some glee, to keep the marked one alive. A chain binds the marked one to a second delver: both are in the beast's eye.
mechanic.nusmp.combat.nen_hunt.e_link.fl: The target is not the strongest. The target is the one who showed fear.

mechanic.nusmp.combat.initiative_round.d: The fight runs in rounds: every few seconds the monsters get a turn, a surge of speed and fury, and then the delvers get theirs. The wise take their turn when the monsters' is over.
mechanic.nusmp.combat.initiative_round.e: The Rounds of Initiative: The Slow Rounds

mechanic.nusmp.combat.witch_cult_horde.d: A cult of the dead witch keeps its dead in the walls: whenever a delver falls, the dead stir, and the cult sends reinforcements to finish the work.
mechanic.nusmp.combat.witch_cult_horde.f: The cult does not mourn. It collects.
mechanic.nusmp.combat.witch_cult_horde.e: The Witch Cult's Horde: The Cult's Reply

The cult does not mourn. It collects.

mechanic.nusmp.combat.witch_cult_horde.e: The Witch Cult's Horde: The Blood Cult

mechanic.nusmp.combat.witch_cult_horde.t: A cult of the dead witch keeps its dead in the walls: whenever a delver falls, the dead stir, and the cult sends reinforcements to finish the work. It smells a wounded delver and strikes when someone drops under half health.
The cult does not mourn. It collects.
mechanic.nusmp.combat.planar_gate.name: The Planar Gate
mechanic.nusmp.combat.planar_gate.desc: A ring of carved doorway stands open on some other plane, and things in transit stumble through: some are fiends, some are lost wanderers, and all of them want out of the draught.
mechanic.nusmp.combat.planar_gate.flavor: The City of Doors has a door for everything, and everything has a door for you.
mechanic.nusmp.combat.planar_gate.e_arca: The Planar Gate: The Arcane Gate

A ring of carved doorway stands open on some other plane, and things in transit stumble through: some are fiends, some are lost wanderers, and all of them want out of the draught. The things that come through are mages.
The City of Doors has a door for everything, and everything has a door for you.

mechanic.nusmp.combat.thrall_court.name: The Court of Thralls
mechanic.nusmp.combat.thrall_court.desc: The count's old court is still in session: his thralls, glassy-eyed and elegant, rise to protect him from anything that moves and bow to anyone who bows first.
mechanic.nusmp.combat.thrall_court.flavo: Come in. Sit down. They never mind visitors.
mechanic.nusmp.combat.thrall_court.e_bat: The Court of Thralls: The Bat Court

The count's old court is still in session: his thralls, glassy-eyed and elegant, rise to protect him from anything that moves and bow to anyone who bows first. The thralls come as a flight of bats: fast and bitey.

mechanic.nusmp.risk.cursed_chest.name: The Cursed Chest
mechanic.nusmp.risk.cursed_chest.desc: A chest on a plinth, locked by nothing but dread: the loot inside is real, and so is the curse that comes out of the lid with it.
mechanic.nusmp.risk.cursed_chest.flavor: Everyone sees the gold. Nobody sees the second lid.
mechanic.nusmp.risk.cursed_chest.e_mimic: The Cursed Chest: The Hungry Chest
A chest on a plinth, locked by nothing but dread: the loot inside is real, and so is the curse that comes out of the lid with it. The chest may also be a mimic.
Everyone sees the gold. Nobody sees the second lid.

mechanic.nusmp.travel.abyss_shaft.name: The Vertical Shaft
mechanic.nusmp.travel.abyss_shaft.desc: A shaft drops into the dark; at its mouth an updraft that holds a body in the air and slowly lets it down: the descent is long, the fall is gentle, and the ascent is a different matter.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.abyss_shaft.e_pres: The Vertical Shaft: The Pressing Shaft

A shaft drops into the dark; at its mouth an updraft that holds a body in the air and slowly lets it down: the descent is long, the fall is gentle, and the ascent is a different matter. A heavier air at the bottom: more of a push down.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.abyss_shaft.t_jump: A shaft drops into the dark; at its mouth an updraft that holds a body in the air and slowly lets it down: the descent is long, the fall is gentle, and the ascent is a different matter. Jumping in its area sets it off.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.abyss_shaft.c_hold: A shaft drops into the dark; at its mouth an updraft that holds a body in the air and slowly lets it down: the descent is long, the fall is gentle, and the ascent is a different matter. Carry a light through it long enough and it relents.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.abyss_shaft.e_dark: The Vertical Shaft: The Dark Shaft

A shaft drops into the dark; at its mouth an updraft that holds a body in the air and slowly lets it down: the descent is long, the fall is gentle, and the ascent is a different matter. The shaft is pitch dark.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.abyss_shaft.t_snea: A shaft drops into the dark; at its mouth an updraft that holds a body in the air and slowly lets it down: the descent is long, the fall is gentle, and the ascent is a different matter. Crouching in its area for a few seconds sets it off.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.abyss_shaft.c_leve: A shaft drops into the dark; at its mouth an updraft that holds a body in the air and slowly lets it down: the descent is long, the fall is gentle, and the ascent is a different matter. A lever somewhere in the area switches it off.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.steam_conveyor.des: A hall of belts driven by an old boiler that carries everything on it along at a steady pace: stand still and be taken, run against it and go nowhere.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.steam_conveyor.fla: Steam is just patience under pressure.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.steam_conveyor.e_r: The Steam Conveyor: The Reverse Belt
A hall of belts driven by an old boiler that carries everything on it along at a steady pace: stand still and be taken, run against it and go nowhere. The belt runs the other way.
Steam is just patience under pressure.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.steam_conveyor.t_p: A hall of belts driven by an old boiler that carries everything on it along at a steady pace: stand still and be taken, run against it and go nowhere. It springs when someone comes within a few blocks of its heart.

mechanic.nusmp.travel.steam_conveyor.e_f: The Steam Conveyor: The Fast Belt

mechanic.nusmp.travel.steam_conveyor.t_t: A hall of belts driven by an old boiler that carries everything on it along at a steady pace: stand still and be taken, run against it and go nowhere. It runs on a timer for as long as anyone stays.
Steam is just patience under pressure.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.frozen_lake.name: The Frozen Lake
mechanic.nusmp.travel.frozen_lake.desc: A hall whose floor is one sheet of ice: slow sliding, no purchase, and a long way to the other side. The ice is old and the cold remembers.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.frozen_lake.flavor: The ice has been there longer than the name of the lake.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.frozen_lake.e_thin: A hall whose floor is one sheet of ice: slow sliding, no purchase, and a long way to the other side. The ice is old and the cold remembers. The ice is thin: a pit opens where weight settles.
The ice has been there longer than the name of the lake.

mechanic.nusmp.travel.slime_bounce.name: The Slime Bounce Pads
mechanic.nusmp.travel.slime_bounce.desc: Pads of resilient jelly in the floor that throw a jumper up and away: the trick is to land on the right one.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.slime_bounce.flavo: Slimes are very good at being bounced on.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.slime_bounce.e_hon: The Slime Bounce Pads: Honey Pads
Pads of resilient jelly in the floor that throw a jumper up and away: the trick is to land on the right one. Sticky honey pads that slow instead of bounce.
Slimes are very good at being bounced on.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.slime_bounce.t_are: Pads of resilient jelly in the floor that throw a jumper up and away: the trick is to land on the right one. It strikes every time someone steps back into the area.
Slimes are very good at being bounced on.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.slime_bounce.c_sta: Pads of resilient jelly in the floor that throw a jumper up and away: the trick is to land on the right one. Hold a marked plate for a few seconds to still it.

mechanic.nusmp.travel.slime_bounce.e_lon: The Slime Bounce Pads: The Long Jump
Pads of resilient jelly in the floor that throw a jumper up and away: the trick is to land on the right one. A bounce that carries a great way sideways.
Slimes are very good at being bounced on.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.slime_bounce.t_pro: Pads of resilient jelly in the floor that throw a jumper up and away: the trick is to land on the right one. It springs when someone comes within a few blocks of its heart.

mechanic.nusmp.travel.kamui_warp.name: The Spiral Warp
mechanic.nusmp.travel.kamui_warp.desc: A spiral in the air that swallows whoever walks into it and spits them out at some other part of the room: the warp is a little different each time, and it has never sent anybody anywhere dull.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.kamui_warp.flavor: A space-time jutsu: the world twisted into a point.
The Spiral Warp: The Home Spiral

A spiral in the air that swallows whoever walks into it and spits them out at some other part of the room: the warp is a little different each time, and it has never sent anybody anywhere dull. The spiral always returns the party to where it entered.
A space-time jutsu: the world twisted into a point.

mechanic.nusmp.travel.rainbow_bridge.des: A chasm with no bridge, crossed by those with the light to make one: every step lays a plank of pale light that fades a moment after the foot has left it.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.rainbow_bridge.fla: A bridge between realms is only as good as the person who walks it.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.rainbow_bridge.e_d: The Bridge of Light: The Bridge of Shadow

A chasm with no bridge, crossed by those with the light to make one: every step lays a plank of pale light that fades a moment after the foot has left it. A bridge of shadow: black glass that fades faster.
A bridge between realms is only as good as the person who walks it.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.rainbow_bridge.t_p: A chasm with no bridge, crossed by those with the light to make one: every step lays a plank of pale light that fades a moment after the foot has left it. It springs when someone comes within a few blocks of its heart.

mechanic.nusmp.travel.rainbow_bridge.e_s: The Bridge of Light: The Steadfast Bridge

mechanic.nusmp.travel.shifting_stairs.de: Stairs that rearrange themselves as they are climbed: some flights are real, some lead nowhere, and the real ones change when the party's back is turned.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.shifting_stairs.fl: The stairs are never where you left them.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.shifting_stairs.e_: The Shifting Stairs: The Floating Steps
Stairs that rearrange themselves as they are climbed: some flights are real, some lead nowhere, and the real ones change when the party's back is turned. Floating steps, a few at a time.

mechanic.nusmp.travel.flying_carpet.name: The Flying Carpet
mechanic.nusmp.travel.flying_carpet.desc: A woven platform that glides across a chasm on a slow, magical wind: a seat for as many as the weaver could fit and no handrail.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.flying_carpet.flav: Up, up, and not too steeply.
The Flying Carpet: The Cross Carpet
A woven platform that glides across a chasm on a slow, magical wind: a seat for as many as the weaver could fit and no handrail. The carpet flies across the room the other way.
Up, up, and not too steeply.

mechanic.nusmp.travel.anywhere_gate.name: The Gate of Nazarick
mechanic.nusmp.travel.anywhere_gate.desc: A dark gate with a gold rim that opens to whichever place its master chooses: the party can ask it, but it only sends them somewhere it has already decided upon.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.anywhere_gate.e_ro: The Gate of Nazarick: The Gate to a Far Hall
A dark gate with a gold rim that opens to whichever place its master chooses: the party can ask it, but it only sends them somewhere it has already decided upon. The gate opens onto another hall.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.anywhere_gate.t_pr: A dark gate with a gold rim that opens to whichever place its master chooses: the party can ask it, but it only sends them somewhere it has already decided upon. It springs when someone comes within a few blocks of its heart.

mechanic.nusmp.travel.anywhere_gate.e_ba: The Gate of Nazarick: The Gate Back

mechanic.nusmp.travel.floating_islands.d: A hall of islands of stone hanging in the air: gravity is light, the gaps are wide, and the way across is a chain of jumps that are never quite where they seem.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.floating_islands.f: Aincrad has many floors, and none of them stay put.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.floating_islands.e: The Floating Islands: The Heavy Islands

mechanic.nusmp.travel.trapdoor_chute.fla: Trapdoor. Roll a Reflex save. Or don't.

mechanic.nusmp.travel.airship_rails.flav: The Golden Dawn's carriage never loses time.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.airship_rails.e_da: The Airship Rails: The Black Bulls' Wagon

mechanic.nusmp.travel.odm_anchors.flavor: Gear up. Swing. Don't think about the ground.

mechanic.nusmp.travel.portal_maze.desc: A hall of doorways to places that may or may not exist, each with a keyhole and a rumour: step through the right one and it is a shortcut, the wrong one and it is somewhere else.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.portal_maze.flavor: There's a door to everywhere, if you know the key.

nusmp.race.lesser_saiyan.description: The first tier of the Saiyan line: a warrior people who fight with ki (aura) rather than magicule. Strong for their kind, quick to grow when hurt (Zenkai), and under a full moon the Great Ape rises from them whether they wish it or not. Evolves into the Medium Saiyan with EP, kills and mastery of Strength.
nusmp.race.medium_saiyan.description: The second tier: a seasoned fighter whose body is hardened (Strengthen Body, Self-Regeneration, pain and physical resistance). Out of a rage at low health the Ascension opens to them. Evolves into the High Saiyan with EP, a boss (or many kills), Strengthen Body mastery and an enchanted golden apple.
nusmp.race.high_saiyan.description: The third tier: steel-bodied and armoured (Steel Strength, Body Armor). A High Saiyan commands the Great Ape at will once their EP is great enough, and can ascend by choice as well as in a rage. Evolves into the Divine Saiyan with EP, ten boss kills (or the Saiyan Legend record), Steel Strength mastery and a Genesis Core.
nusmp.race.divine_saiyan.description: The top of the Saiyan line: a god among warriors with Divine Ki Release, thought acceleration and ultraspeed regeneration. The only race that can take the Divine Form, a short, costly state that can be entered only once in twenty minutes.
nusmp.race.primordial.description: A being of pure mana, the top of a line of its own: a huge magicule pool and spiritual body, mana manipulation, Magic Aura and Magic Sense, and resistance to magic. Nothing in the Saiyan line leads here; you become a Primordial through the Primordial Rite (/multiverse elite race rite), which asks for EP, a Genesis Core, Mana Manipulation mastery and boss kills.

nusmp.skill.ancient_soul.description: Extra. Kills leave fragments of old souls in you; part of any magic that hits you never lands. Press to spend 20 fragments and mend yourself.
nusmp.skill.basilisk_skin.description: Ultimate. Scales turn aside much ordinary damage, poison and wither cannot take hold, and melee hits are thrown back as venom. Petrifying Gaze turns the foes before you to stone; Molt sheds the skin for a shield.
nusmp.skill.beelzebuth.description: Ultimate. Gluttony: kills heal you, feed your magicules and stack Hunger (more damage). Devour bites a foe and heals you, Maw drags foes in, Domain eats at everything around you.
nusmp.skill.crocodile_skin.description: Unique. A hide that turns aside a fifth of ordinary damage (more in water, where you also hit harder). Death Roll grips the foe you look at and rolls it three times, healing you.
nusmp.skill.gaia.description: Ultimate. Raise a domain of the earth mother: allies are blessed, strangers cannot break the ground, pillars strike the foes before you, and the domain's gathered life blooms veins of ore.
nusmp.skill.gravity_well.description: Aspectual magic (gravity). Open a well where you look: it pulls foes in, crushes and slows them, then collapses. The second mode collapses your well early.
nusmp.skill.hecate.description: Unique. Three faces of the moon: the Maiden's piercing Moonbolt, the Mother's healing blessing, the Crone's hex of the crossroads. Each is strongest at its own moon phase, and weaker by day.
nusmp.skill.hephaestus_ultimate.descript: Ultimate. Reforge every tool and piece of armour you carry, Temper the weapon in your hand for more damage, or drop a Molten Anvil on the foes where you look.
nusmp.skill.iron_resolve.description: Extra. Wounded, every blow you take stacks Resolve: less damage and, from three stacks, no knockback. Press to Brace and halve all damage for three seconds.
nusmp.skill.kaioken.description: Intrinsic. Toggle. Multiply your own body (x2, x3, x4; x10 and x20 once mastered): more melee damage and speed, but it burns your health every second and leaves you spent.
nusmp.skill.kamehameha.description: Aspectual magic. Hold to gather ki (up to five levels), release to fire a piercing beam. A fuller charge is longer, wider and harder; letting go too early costs nothing.
nusmp.skill.mechanical_eye.description: Intrinsic. Scan Pulse lights the foes around you and reads the nearest one out (health, armour, damage). Weak Point marks the foe you look at: your hits on it are 20% stronger for ten seconds.
nusmp.skill.mechanical_hands.description: Intrinsic. Extend Arms for a longer reach, Telekinesis to pull dropped items and orbs to you, Mend to restore part of the durability of the tool in your hand.
nusmp.skill.meditation.description: Extra. Toggle. Keep still and unhurt and Focus builds: magicules (and later health) return every second. Moving or being hurt breaks it.

nusmp.skill.msg.void_edge.imbued: The void clings to your blade.
nusmp.skill.msg.void_sovereign.blocked: There is no room to step.
nusmp.skill.msg.void_sovereign.nullified: Space refuses to move for you.
nusmp.skill.ouroboros.description: Ultimate. The cycle undoes itself: Rewind returns you to where and how you were ten seconds ago, Cycle resets every other cooldown of yours, and a killing blow can be undone by itself once in a while.
nusmp.skill.rapheal.description: Ultimate. Wisdom: some blows are foreseen and turned aside. Analyze reads and marks a foe, Thought Acceleration quickens you and your cooldowns, Dissect strips a foe's blessings.
nusmp.skill.runesmiths_insight.descripti: Extra. Read the runes and enchantments of the item in your hand, or inscribe a Fire, Frost, Thunder or Vitality rune on your weapon for a few minutes.
nusmp.skill.scavenger.description: Extra. Your kills sometimes leave one more stack of loot. Press to Sniff Out every dropped item around you: they glow for twenty seconds.
nusmp.skill.static_chain.description: Aspectual magic (lightning). A bolt strikes the foe you look at and jumps from foe to foe, then tethers them together so they cannot scatter.
nusmp.skill.void_edge.description: Unique. Imbue your melee with the void: each blow deals a second, armour-ignoring hit, breaks shields and strips armour. Void Slash sends a cutting wave through everything in a line.
nusmp.skill.void_sovereign.description: Ultimate. Void Domain: foes inside cannot teleport and foreign projectiles are erased. Void Step cuts a line of space while you cross it. Collapse closes space on the foes around you.
_note: Lang fragment of the map-mod compatibility (docs/compat/maps.md). Merge into assets/nusmp/lang/en_us.json (not edited by this branch). Every message key below also has the same English text as its in-code fallback, so the game reads well before the merge. The biome and dimension names are what a minimap (Xaero's shows the biome name) and a world map display for the mod's biomes and dimensions; without them the raw key is shown.
